releases.title: onnagäta Release Debut Album Point to Where It Hurts, Out Now Via Pashtone Entertainment
releases.body:
"Someone in the Trunk" video starring Yellowstone and Hulu's Furious actor Clark Moore arrives November 20

VENTURA, Calif., Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Ventura/Los Angeles rock band onnagäta have released their debut album, Point to Where It Hurts, out now on all streaming platforms via Pashtone Entertainment, with an LP to follow.

The album opens with "Sidewalk Romeo," which introduces a character who rears his head in different forms across nearly every song that follows. The sound sits at the crossroads of grunge fury and desert-rock intensity.

onnagäta began with guitarist/vocalist Kasey Herbison and drummer Nathan L. Morris, who first played together under the onnagäta name in 2009 and have yet to come up with a better one. The pair recorded the album at Captain's Quarters in Ventura with Vincent Amador of Oxnard hardcore band Dead Heat engineering. Armand John Anthony of Ventura heavy metal band Night Demon co-produced and mixed, and Nicholas Townsend mastered. Herbison and Morris played nearly every instrument themselves, down to faucet handles and toilet water, both of which made the final mix. Kenny Benson added guitar, bass, and ebow, and Hekar Rivera contributed cello and violin. The sessions ran significantly over schedule while somehow staying under budget, fueled by coffee and The Habit Burger & Grill.

"'Sidewalk Romeo' was real spur of the moment," says Morris. "We kept adding parts and pushed the linear song structure, but I think the song has a theatrical arc that's congruent lyrically with the downfall of the character of Romeo."

Point to Where It Hurts includes the singles "Chatterbox," released with a music video and on 7-inch vinyl, and "Slipping." On November 20, album track "Someone in the Trunk" gets its own music video: a dusty road movie directed by Morris, shot by Alecks Auclair, and starring Yellowstone actor Clark Moore as a scraggly driver who kidnaps the band and takes them on a joy ride. The getaway car, a bitchin' 1971 Cadillac Coupe de Ville, was borrowed from a man named Dino. All band members have been accounted for, and the car was returned.

"I've always enjoyed the main riff. It's easy to get into right from the start. And the lyrics take it to another dimension," says Herbison.

"The title may have subconsciously come from a line in Sling Blade," says Morris.

onnagäta's live lineup is rounded out by Kenny Benson on guitar and Aaron Payan on bass, who joined after the album was recorded. The band has opened for Far frontman Jonah Matranga's oneLOUDdrawing and was featured on 95.5 KLOS's "Stay or Go" morning segment. If you're wondering, they stayed.

Website: https://onnagata.com

Listen to "Point to Where It Hurts": https://open.spotify.com/album/1yzI99Ng9hfqo8VshC957a

Watch "Chatterbox": https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5r-44JHV2iw

"Someone in the Trunk" premieres November 20 on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@onnagatamusic

Instagram: @onnagatamusic

Press Contact

releases.body:
ATLANTA, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Global law firm Greenberg Traurig, LLP's Entertainment, Media & Sports Practice congratulates its clients Miranda Lambert and Brooks & Dunn on their wins at the 60th annual Country Music Association (CMA) Awards, held Nov. 18.

"Congratulations to our clients on this well-deserved recognition. Their wins as a producer, songwriter, and vocal duo reflect the exceptional talent and lasting contributions they bring to country music," Atlanta Entertainment & Media Practice Co-Chair Jess Rosen said. "We are proud to support them and celebrate these achievements."

Greenberg Traurig clients earned four awards across four categories:

Single of the Year

  • Miranda Lambert, producer ("Choosin' Texas")

Album of the Year

  • Miranda Lambert, producer (Dandelion)

Song of the Year

  • Miranda Lambert, songwriter ("Choosin' Texas")

Vocal Duo of the Year

  • Brooks & Dunn

"We are honored to work with these clients and congratulate them on their CMA Award wins. We also congratulate our longtime client, the CMA, and are delighted to support its work recognizing creative talent and advancing country music," said Bobby Rosenbloum, chair of the Global Entertainment & Media Practice.

Rosen and Rosenbloum represent the clients who were honored this year. Both have spent over four decades advising country music artists, songwriters, producers, executives, and other entertainment professionals on significant business and career opportunities across music, film, television, and new media. They work alongside practice colleagues who serve clients throughout the entertainment and media industries.

The CMA Awards celebrate excellence in country music, honoring both established artists and emerging talent. The CMA Awards are recognized as the longest-running annual music awards program on network television.

About Greenberg Traurig's Entertainment & Media Practice: With offices situated in the centers of the entertainment industry, Greenberg Traurig has established an experienced, international multidisciplinary entertainment and media practice. The Greenberg Traurig Entertainment & Media Practice focuses on the music, motion picture, television, live stage, internet, digital media, publishing, sports, theatre, and cable industries. The team has access to key players in the entertainment and media sectors and provides clients with timely, business-oriented, and dedicated legal counsel essential for thriving in today's dynamic, multimedia entertainment marketplace. Our entertainment and media attorneys have been consistently recognized as Billboard "Top Music Lawyers" and "Country Power Players," The Hollywood Reporter "Power Lawyers: Top 100 Most Influential Entertainment Lawyers in America," and as a Law360 "Practice Group of the Year"; in the Variety "Dealmakers Impact Report," "Legal Impact Report," and "Variety 500," Chambers USA Guide, The Legal 500, Super Lawyers, and The Best Lawyers in America.

About Greenberg Traurig: Greenberg Traurig, LLP has approximately 3,200 lawyers across 51 locations in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Latin America, and Asia. The firm's broad geographic and practice range enables the delivery of innovative and strategic legal services across borders and industries. Recognized as a 2025 BTI "Best of the Best Recommended Law Firm" by general counsel for trust and relationship management, Greenberg Traurig is consistently ranked among the top firms on the Am Law Global 100, NLJ 500, and Law360 400. Greenberg Traurig is also known for its philanthropic giving, culture, innovation, and pro bono work. Web: www.gtlaw.com.

SEAWORLD BRINGS LIVE MUSIC TO 2027 WITH EXPANDED AND ELEVATED CONCERT SERIES FEATURING MORE THAN 50 SHOWS

ALL-NEW Expanded Nationwide Concert Lineup Features Headlining Musical Acts, Performing Full Length Concerts, Included with Park Admission
releases.title: SEAWORLD BRINGS LIVE MUSIC TO 2027 WITH EXPANDED AND ELEVATED CONCERT SERIES FEATURING MORE THAN 50 SHOWS
releases.body:
ALL-NEW Expanded Nationwide Concert Lineup Features Headlining Musical Acts, Performing Full Length Concerts, Included with Park Admission

ORLANDO, Fla. and SAN DIEGO and SAN ANTONIO, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SeaWorld is ready to groove in 2027 with an expanded and elevated, coast-to-coast live music concert series featuring more than 50 live shows, unveiled today across its parks in Orlando, San Diego and San Antonio. An added value for guests, the full-length concerts of 60+ minutes feature more headlining acts, all included with park admission. For fans who want to catch every show, an Annual Pass is the best option, opening the door to the full 2027 lineup.

Florida's own Flo Rida will kick off SeaWorld Orlando's popular Seven Seas Food Festival concert series on January 30, 2027, featuring 29 concerts with live performances most Saturdays and Sundays through May 16, 2027. SeaWorld San Diego offers 16 concerts starting on March 20 through the end of August and SeaWorld San Antonio features seven spring concerts from April through May. The 2027 series blends a range of genres, nostalgia-driven favorites and contemporary performers, offering guests multiple opportunities to enjoy full-length live concerts.

The national lineup includes acts such as Flo Rida, Lee Brice, Taking Back Sunday, Nicky Jam, Soulja Boy, K-pop group Everglow, Lil Jon, Justin Moore, JoJo Siwa, Skillet, Luisa Sonza, Sugar Ray, Elvis Crespo, CeeLo Green, E-40 and Rick Ross.

With concerts included in park admission and available across multiple events and weekends, an Annual Pass offers guests the most flexible way to access the full 2027 concert lineup from the start of the season. With the biggest sale of the year happening now for Black Friday, guests can take advantage of savings up to 65% on Annual Passes.

Guests wanting to get a front row seat for a maximum concert experience can purchase reserved access.

Guests can expect:

  • Full-length live concerts, 60+ minutes, included with all forms of park admission
  • A full-day park experience that pairs food festivals, attractions, and animal encounters with evening live music performances
  • The flexibility to attend multiple concerts throughout the season with an Annual Pass
  • Limited-time ticket and Pass offers available by location
  • Option to upgrade concert experience with reserved access

"We're very excited about our concert series for 2027," said Marc Swanson, CEO of United Parks & Resorts. "We've booked headline-worthy performers across a broad mix of genres, appealing to a wide variety of music lovers. It's a thrilling addition to a SeaWorld day, and it really showcases the fun and outstanding value these parks offer."

SeaWorld Orlando

This year's Seven Seas Food Festival takes guests on a musical and culinary journey around the world, drawing inspiration from the sounds and flavors of different destinations. At Bayside Stadium, the festival will feature 29 full-length concerts on select dates from late January through mid-May.

Program highlights include:

  • A broad mix of country, pop, classic rock, alternative rock, hard rock, Latin, hip-hop, R&B, rap, reggae, K-pop, and Electronic/EDM.
  • Featured performers such as Flo Rida, Lee Brice, Taking Back Sunday, JoJo Siwa, Blue Oyster Cult, Skillet, Shaggy, K-pop group EVERGLOW, Lil Jon, Justin Moore, Soulja Boy, Scotty McCreery and Luisa Sonza.
  • Weekend concerts staged at Bayside Stadium throughout the spring season.

SeaWorld San Diego

SeaWorld San Diego's live music series delivers 16 live concerts, running from spring through late summer across two signature seasonal events.

Program highlights include:

  • Concerts performed at the Bayside Amphitheater along Mission Bay.
  • Performances integrated into the Seven Seas Food Festival and Summer Concert Series.
  • A genre-spanning lineup featuring hip-hop, R&B, rap, pop, and rock, with throwback favorites alongside contemporary artists, including Rick Ross, E-40, CeeLo Green, Lil Jon, Soulja Boy, Ying Yang Twins, Taking Back Sunday, and Juvenile.

SeaWorld San Antonio

SeaWorld San Antonio includes seven live full-length concerts as part of its Seven Seas Food Festival in 2027, adding select concerts to the spring season.

Program highlights include:

  • Performance dates from mid-April through late May.
  • A mix of rock, hip-hop, pop, Latin, Christian, and throwback music.
  • Acts include Sugar Ray, Elvis Crespo, Skillet, JoJo Siwa, Soulja Boy, Puddle of Mudd, Alien Ant Farm, and Pop 2000 featuring Chris Kirkpatrick of *NSYNC, O-Town, Ryan Cabrera, and LFO.

Guest Access and Annual Pass Value

SeaWorld's 2027 concert series is included with regular park admission, giving guests added value during their visit. Annual Pass Members can enjoy season-long access to multiple concerts across parks and events, along with the flexibility to attend performances throughout the spring and summer.

For a limited time, guests can take advantage of the Black Friday Sale, the biggest of the year, with savings up to 65% off Annual Passes, the best way to enjoy as many concerts as guests would like.

Park-specific concert schedules, ticket options, and Annual Pass details are available at SeaWorld Orlando, SeaWorld San Diego and SeaWorld San Antonio.

About SeaWorld

SeaWorld is a leading marine life theme park and accredited zoo and aquarium that provides experiences that matter while educating and inspiring guests of all ages to care about marine life. Welcoming millions of guests every year, the parks offer fun and enriching experiences ranging from up-close animal encounters and year-round educational programs to award-winning marine-life-themed rides, special events, and live entertainment. For more than 60 years, SeaWorld has advanced marine conservation through science, education, and exceptional animal care. SeaWorld is one of the largest marine animal rescue organizations in the world, having helped more than 43,000 animals to date. SeaWorld parks are in Orlando, San Antonio, San Diego, and Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates (UAE). SeaWorld is part of the United Parks & Resorts Inc. (NYSE: PRKS) portfolio of theme park brands. For more information, visit SeaWorld.com.

releases.title: Vail Resorts Turns Up the Volume with ILLENIUM in Vail, John Summit in Whistler and a Full Winter of Music and Mountain Culture
releases.body:
• ILLENIUM opens Vail Mountain's biggest music season to date on Dec. 11, 2026, and John Summit returns to Whistler Blackcomb on March 20-21, 2027
  • Guests who want a front-row seat to music and culture in the mountains should lock in an Epic Pass; Last chance to buy a Pass is December 6

Images Approved for Media Use Available HERE

BROOMFIELD, Colo., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Vail Resorts is turning up the volume this winter. GRAMMY-nominated producer ILLENIUM opens Vail Mountain's biggest music season to date on Dec. 11, 2026, and John Summit returns to Whistler Blackcomb on March 20-21, 2027, headlining a season of live music, après and mountain culture across the company's resorts. Additional headline performances will be announced as the season gets underway.

From on-mountain DJ sets to village celebrations, intimate dinners and milestone anniversaries, resorts including Vail Mountain, Breckenridge, Whistler Blackcomb, Park City Mountain, Beaver Creek Resort, Keystone Resort, and Heavenly Mountain Resort will host new events and returning favorites that immerse guests in music and mountain culture. Vail Mountain leads the way with seven on-mountain pop-up performances – three more than last season – plus two new on-mountain music venues. Guests who want a front-row seat to the season should lock in an Epic Pass; last chance to buy a Pass is December 6.

"Music and après culture have always been part of our mountain experience," said Jody Churich, Senior Vice President of Destination Resorts at Vail Resorts. "From ILLENIUM in Vail and John Summit in Whistler to village performances and dance parties, these are experiences people will remember long after the lifts stop spinning. This winter, we're bringing even more of them to resorts across our mountain portfolio."

Music Across the Mountains

Headline Performances: From GRAMMY-nominated headliners in Vail to a house music takeover in Whistler, the season's biggest names bring festival energy to the mountains.

  • At Vail Mountain (CO), GRAMMY-nominated, multi-platinum recording artists ILLENIUM opens the 2026/27 music season Dec. 11 at the newly renovated Dobson Arena in Lionshead. Ian Asher follows Jan. 16, with tickets available at AXS.com. Another headliner will be announced for an April 10 show at Dobson.
  • At Whistler Blackcomb (BC), John Summit's Experts Only returns to Lot 7 March 20–21 after making its Whistler debut last March. More lineup details are coming soon, and tickets are available HERE.
  • At Heavenly (CA/NV), Elderbrook headlines the Season Kickoff party Dec. 19 at Lakeview Lodge, high above Lake Tahoe, setting the tone for a winter of DJ performances.
  • At Park City Mountain (UT), the energy of Shaun White's The Snow League spills over from the superpipe to Eagle Plaza in Mountain Village where LP Giobbi performs Jan. 22 and Dombresky brings Disco Dom on Jan. 23. Both shows are free and open to the public.

Après and Live Music: From DJ sets at the base of Vail Mountain's Gondola One to mountaintop music sessions on Whistler Mountain, guests will find new and returning ways to keep the energy going on mountain and after the lifts stop spinning.

  • At Vail Mountain (CO), this is the biggest music season yet, with seven on-mountain performances (three more than last winter) and two new music venues. Vail Après Club™ builds on a 2025/26 season that brought globally recognized artists including Sofi Tukker, Dillon Francis, Chris Lorenzo and John Summit to the mountain. This season, new artists, venues and mountain activations will be announced on social media @VailMtn. Every Friday, Saturday and Sunday from 2:30 to 5:30 p.m., Après All Day at Vail Express Lift Bar brings more than 50 performing artists to the stage, nearly double than last season, in collaboration with Vail Mountain partner Outer Range Brewing Co. Next to the Legendary Back Bowls Gate, the reimagined Vail Ice Bar blends alpine nostalgia with a lively outdoor gathering space for drinks, music and après in the heart of the mountain.
  • At Breckenridge (CO), the Kingdom of Breck™ comes to life with high-energy live music across the mountain and in town. The excitement begins during the Rockstar Energy Open with free performances by RL Grime and PHRVA at Blue River Plaza. Throughout the season, and perched high on Peak 9, The Overlook becomes an après destination for the Après at the Overlook Music Series, with live DJ sets and drink specials set against 11,000-foot views. Nearby, Keystone (CO) brings back Keystone After Dark, inviting guests to keep après going into the evening near the largest mountaintop snow structure in North America on six select dates.
  • At Whistler Blackcomb (BC), the village après scene is as much a part of the trip as the alpine. Whistler favorites including the Hairfarmers and Taylor James will play at Merlin's, GLC and Dusty's all season long. Up top, the popular Corona DJ Sessions return to the Corona Mountain Top Lodge on Whistler Mountain starting Jan. 17, with more details coming soon.
  • At Park City Mountain (UT), Canyons Village is the place to be when the lifts stop spinning. Après at the Airstream DJ sets keep the energy going at the Umbrella Bar every Friday, Saturday and Sunday from 2 to 5 p.m. starting Nov. 27. Canyons Village Silver Sky Nights pair live music with fireworks over the village on Dec. 18, Jan. 16, Feb. 6 and Feb. 13.
  • At Heavenly (CA/NV), après comes with a view of Lake Tahoe. The Views and Vibes series brings popular DJs including Elderbrook, Bob Moses, Vandelux and Snakehips to the stage high above the lake all season long.
  • At Mount Snow (VT), the après traditions run deep and the parties run late. Snow Barn, a rite of passage for any Mount Snow visit, brings live music, DJs and late-night entertainment starting Dec. 19, with acts including One More Time, Lazer Dad and Haus of Monsters. Local favorite Bruce Jacques returns to Cuzzins for another season of sing-along performances, and reservations go fast. On Jan. 30, the Carinthia Lodge House Party fills all three floors of the lodge with music, drinks and games. In spring, Reggaefest brings live reggae from IRIEspect to the main stage March 20–22.

"There's an energy in a mountain town when the music starts, and at many of our resorts you'll hear it from the slopes all the way into town," said Churich. "It might be a band on a sunny mountaintop deck or a headliner on a village stage after the lifts stop. Whether guests are front row for the big show or dancing in ski boots with friends after a day on the snow, we want every one of them to leave with a story and an unforgettable moment."

Epic Pass Holders Get More Out of Every Event; Last chance to buy a Pass is December 6

Last chance to buy an Epic Pass is Dec. 6, so guests eager to get on the mountain this winter still have time to lock in access and savings. With new savings for young adults, guests ages 13–30 save 20% on an Epic Pass or Epic Local Pass. Plus, all guests who purchase an Epic Pass or Epic Local Pass now will receive five Epic Friend Tickets offering 50% off adult lift tickets, making it easier to bring the crew along and save. Epic Pass Holders can also save on the rest of their trip with exclusive savings through Epic Mountain Rewards, including 20% off food, lodging, lessons, rentals, and more.

About Vail Resorts, Inc.

Vail Resorts operates a network of 42 iconic mountain resorts across North America, Europe, and Australia. Our portfolio includes premier destinations such as Vail Mountain, Beaver Creek, Breckenridge, Park City Mountain, Whistler Blackcomb, and Keystone; beloved regional mountains like Stowe, Heavenly, and Northstar; and local resorts close to metro areas that help to introduce the next generation of skiers and riders to the sport. Together, these resorts provide guests with an unmatched range of mountain experiences connected through the Epic Pass. We are passionate about providing an Experience of a Lifetime to our team members and guests. Through our environmental and social responsibility work, we are committed to reaching a zero net operating footprint by 2030, supporting our employees and communities, and broadening engagement in our sport. Beyond our resorts, Vail Resorts operates industry-leading ski and ride school programs, rental operations, distinctive dining and hospitality experiences, retail operations, and the Grand Teton Lodge Company. Learn more about our company at www.VailResorts.com, or discover our resorts and Pass options at www.EpicPass.com.

releases.title: INTERLOCHEN CENTER FOR THE ARTS JOINED BY NEW FACULTY OF INDUSTRY PROFESSIONALS ACROSS MUSIC, VISUAL ARTS, CREATIVE WRITING, FILM & BEYOND
releases.body:
INTERLOCHEN, Mich., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- This year in its centennial year, Interlochen Center for the Arts is proud to welcome 596 young artists from 47 states and 32 countries – including 47 creative writers, 52 dancers, 29 filmmakers and animators, 265 musicians, 124 thespians, as well as 53 visual and 26 interdisciplinary artists. Named by Niche as the #1 Best High School for the Arts in America for the second consecutive year, a central part of this award-winning education is their world-class faculty.

In its centennial year, Interlochen Center for the Arts is proud to welcome 14 new artistic and academic educators.

This academic year, Interlochen is thrilled to welcome 14 new artistic and academic educators to Interlochen Arts Academy, joining their existing, dedicated team of faculty, artists, and mentors. This new faculty will continue Interlochen's mission to create a singular place where young artists turn their passion and potential into purpose.

Recently announced is Interlochen's partnership with the Chicago Symphony, the Los Angeles Philharmonic, and the University of Michigan's University Musical Society (UMS) to mark Interlochen's centennial and promote world friendship with a March 2028 tour. Cristian Măcelaru and famed pianist Lang Lang—both celebrated international ambassadors for the arts—will be part this one-of-a-kind collaboration: Lang Lang will join students on Interlochen's campus for master classes and rehearsals and will perform with them on stage under the baton of Cristian Măcelaru for concerts at Interlochen's Corson Auditorium (March 10, 2028), Ann Arbor's Hill Auditorium at the University of Michigan (March 12, 2028), Chicago Symphony Center (March 14, 2028), and Los Angeles' Walt Disney Concert Hall (March 17, 2028).

Discover more about a few of Interlochen's new faculty members:

STEVE MYERSON, HAMANN FAMILY JAZZ PIANO CHAIR

Myerson's career has been shaped by celebrated jazz musicians and educators including Harold Mabern and Bill Charlap. Over the years, he has performed with diverse world-class artists including renowned bassist Christian McBride, legendary saxophonist Grover Washington Jr., and R&B group The Stylistics. He most recently served as Adjunct Professor of Jazz Studies at William Paterson University in New Jersey.

MICHAEL ROSSI, INSTRUCTOR OF VISUAL ARTS, SCULPTURE

Rossi is a professional metalworker with 25 years of experience and founder of Rossi Metal Design. In 2016, Rossi received the Grand Jury Award from the Preservation Alliance of Greater Philadelphia for the restoration of the two-story tall doors of Founder's Hall at Girard College. The following year, he was involved in the production and permanent installation of Grotto for Mona, a large-scale work by Randy Polumbo at the Museum of Old and New Art in Tasmania, Australia.

MICHAEL PIOTROWSKI, ADJUNCT INSTRUCTOR OF FILM & NEW MEDIA

Piotrowski is a veteran production sound mixer and member of the Cinema Audio Society. He has collaborated on major studio productions including Transformers, Star Trek, Ender's Game, and WandaVision. Piotrowski's work spans from large-scale action films to television, as well as independent productions. Originally from northern Michigan, Piotrowski will be bringing his passion for storytelling and technical expertise back to Interlochen's 29 film and animation students.

CHRISTOPHER MOREHOUSE, CONDUCTOR OF WIND SYMPHONY

Morehouse joins Interlochen after serving as Director of Bands and Professor of Conducting at Southern Illinois University. In 2008, he made his Carnegie Hall debut with the SIU Wind Ensemble at the New York Band and Orchestra Festival, working with notable composers. Morehouse's artistic collaborations include composers-in-residence Augusta Read Thomas, Morten Lauridsen, Bernard Rands, Chen Yi, Susan Botti, and Dana Wilson, among others. He is also published in ten volumes of the Teaching Music through Performance in Band series published by GIA Publications.

Among the new faculty, adjunct and visiting professors announced are also André Peele (Interim Instructor of Voice), Meredith Stemen (Collaborative Pianist), David Wharton (Instructor of Trumpet), Fez Avery (Visiting Instructor of Creative Writing), Daniel Kohler (Instructor of Math & Science), Kimberly Baker (Instructor of English), Kevin Postma (Instructor of Science), Jennifer Decew (Instructor of Math), Jacob Wheeler (Adjunct Instructor of Journalism), Jill Beauchamp (Adjunct Instructor of English).

About Interlochen Center for the Arts

The nonprofit Interlochen Center for the Arts is a recipient of the National Medal of Arts and the only organization in the world that brings together a 3,000-student summer camp program; a 550-plus-student fine arts boarding high school; a year-round source of expert online arts education for children, teens, and adults; opportunities for adults to engage in fulfilling artistic and creative programs; two 24-hour, listener-supported public radio services (classical music and news); more than 600 arts presentations annually by students, faculty, and world-renowned guest artists; a robust hospitality division that curates on-campus lodging, dining, and transportation services; and a global alumni base spanning nine decades, including leaders in the arts and all other endeavors. For information, visit Interlochen online at www.interlochen.org.

releases.title: The Charming Taste of Europe Returns as Major Sponsor of the European Union Film Festival in Toronto
releases.body:
The EU-funded campaign celebrates European cinema and winemaking with a special wine tasting ahead of the Italian film Life Is Life on November 22

TORONTO, Nov. 19, 2026 /CNW/ -- The Charming Taste of Europe, a campaign co-funded by the European Union, is pleased to announce its continued partnership with the European Union Film Festival (EUFF) in Toronto, returning as a Major Sponsor of the 2026 edition. Now in its 22nd year, the festival celebrates the creativity and diversity of European cinema, bringing together films from across the continent and offering Canadian audiences a unique opportunity to discover Europe's rich cultural and artistic heritage.

The EUFF 2026 runs from November 12 to 26 at the Alliance Française Spadina Theatre in Toronto, with an online edition taking place from December 1 to 20, extending the celebration of European cinema to audiences across Canada.

As part of this year's festival, The Charming Taste of Europe will host a special wine tasting on November 22, from 7:30 p.m. to 8:15 p.m. at the Spadina Theatre, ahead of the 8:30 p.m. screening of Life Is Life, the Italian film featured in the festival's program. The tasting will offer attendees an opportunity to discover European winemaking traditions while enjoying an evening dedicated to Italian cinema and culture.

Through this experience, The Charming Taste of Europe brings together two expressions of European identity: the art of filmmaking and the craftsmanship of winemaking. Both reflect the traditions, creativity, and sense of place that have shaped Europe's cultural heritage, offering festivalgoers an opportunity to explore the continent's diversity beyond the screen.

The renewed partnership with the European Union Film Festival reinforces The Charming Taste of Europe's commitment to connecting European culture with its distinctive agricultural products. Building on its participation in previous editions, the campaign continues to engage Canadian audiences through experiences that celebrate the quality, authenticity, and heritage of European food and wine.

The initiative is part of The Charming Taste of Europe, a campaign promoted by the Consorzio Tutela Vini d'Abruzzo, the Union of Late Harvest Wines of Bordeaux, and the Association of Agricultural Cooperatives of Imathia, representing fresh kiwis from Northern Greece. Co-funded by the European Union, the program aims to increase awareness and appreciation of high-quality European agricultural products in the United States and Canada.

About The Charming Taste of Europe

Europe, a place with timeless charm, is the birthplace of some of the highest-quality products in the world. The Charming Taste of Europe is a special project that introduces exquisite specialties to the United States and Canada, such as Italian and French wines, and fresh kiwis from Greece, that showcase Europe's charm, beauty, culture, history, art, heritage and unmistakable tastes.

The mission of the Charming Taste of Europe, co-funded by the European Union, is to increase awareness of the merits and quality standards of select European wines and fresh fruits with promotional activities in the competitive markets of the U.S. and Canada. The Charming Taste of Europe is promoted by the Consortium for the Protection of Wines of Abruzzo, the Association of Imathia's Agricultural Cooperatives and Union Des Vins Doux de Bordeaux. These European agricultural products, famous around the world for their outstanding qualities, will continue to be promoted with initiatives and events for consumers, journalists and trade professionals. For more information visit charmingtasteofeurope.eu

In WOLF CRE3K, a family of American tourists wander innocently into Mick Taylor's hunting grounds. When the parents sacrifice themselves to save their children, the kids find themselves alone, lost and hunted in the vast Australian wilderness. Find the sneak peek here.

Joining Jarratt in the cast is Ditch Davey (Spartacus, War Machine), Laura Gordon (Late Night with the Devil, Undertow), Stacy Clausen (Leviticus,The Mosquito Bowl), Charli Penton (Neighbours, Insidious: The Bleeding World), Anni Finsterer (Sweet Country, The Gloaming), Meg Fraser (Barons, Welcome Back To My Channel), Carlos Sanson Jnr (Bump, Primitive War), Maria Thattil (Empire City, Mother and Son), Connor Pullinger (The Hunting, Treasure & Dirt) and in his first acting role, Michael Teng, best known as one of the 'Travel Guides' in the popular Australian television series. SEOUL, South Korea, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Ahead of World Children's Day, The Pinkfong Company, the global entertainment company behind Baby Shark, has announced its new holiday film, Baby Shark Christmas Special: The Santa Contest, set to hit cinemas across five countries starting December 4. Building on the global success of Baby Shark Dance, YouTube's most-viewed video of all time with 17.5 billion views, the film brings an interactive Christmas musical adventure to families worldwide.

The story follows Baby Shark and William as they enter an underwater Santa contest after Walrus Santa is injured, only to face an unexpected rival: Thief Baby Shark, a mischievous new character who looks just like Baby Shark. Blending vibrant animation with live-action musical segments, the film invites audiences to sing and dance along. Baby Shark Boy, the original star of the viral Baby Shark Dance video, also returns to the screen a decade later as an on-screen MC to lead a Pinkfong Christmas carol medley.

The theatrical rollout begins December 4 in the UK, Ireland, the UAE, and Indonesia, followed by South Korea on December 5. Screenings will take place at major cinema chains, including ODEON, Light Cinemas, Reel Cinemas, and CGV. From mid-December, the film will also be available in the United States and other markets through digital platforms, including Amazon Prime Video and Roku.

A 15-track deluxe soundtrack featuring seven new songs will be released on November 27 across major global music streaming platforms, including Spotify and Apple Music. Meet-and-greet events are also scheduled for December 5 and 6 at ODEON cinemas in Manchester (Trafford Centre) and Liverpool (Switch Island), alongside a bus advertising campaign in both cities.

Earlier this year, Bebefinn Sing-Along Movie: Into the Pinkfong World entered Netflix's Top 10 Kids Movies chart in 11 markets worldwide, reaching No. 1 in the United States and Ireland. The upcoming film builds on that success, further expanding The Pinkfong Company's family film portfolio and global reach. 

"Baby Shark has brought joy to families around the world through music, and we're excited to bring that experience to the big screen this Christmas," said Gemma Joo, Chief Business Officer at The Pinkfong Company. "By expanding our theatrical and digital reach, we aim to create more ways for families to connect with our stories and enjoy memorable experiences together."

About The Pinkfong Company

The Pinkfong Company is a global family entertainment company that delivers content and entertaining experiences around the world. Driven by award-winning brands and IPs, the company has created and distributed a range of content across genres and formats including original animated series, world live tours, interactive games, and more. Believing in the power of entertaining and engaging content, The Pinkfong Company is committed to connecting people around the world and bringing joy and inspiration to worldwide audiences of all ages. For more information, please visit the website or follow the company on LinkedIn.

About Pinkfong Baby Shark

Since its launch in November 2015, Pinkfong's Baby Shark has become a global phenomenon, combining music, characters, storytelling, and dance. Baby Shark Dance became the first YouTube video to reach 10 billion views and remains the platform's most-watched video, with over 17 billion views to date. The song charted for 20 weeks on the Billboard Hot 100 and peaked #6 on the UK Official Singles Chart. It also earned RIAA Diamond certification (11× Platinum) and 5× Platinum certification in the UK. In 2026, "Baby Shark" became the first character-driven song to join Spotify's Billions Club, surpassing 1 billion streams. Beyond music, Baby Shark has grown into a global entertainment franchise spanning animated series, films, consumer products, live shows, and digital experiences.

releases.title: Morgan Jay, Hello Party Premiere 'Music Therapy with Morgan Jay' Exclusively on YouTube
releases.body:
The Live Nation Studios-backed series drops its first episode on November 18 and signals a new model for creator-led content

AUSTIN, Texas, Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Comedian and musician Morgan Jay, whose viral auto-tuned crowd-work songs have earned him 20.9 million followers across social platforms, today premiered "Music Therapy with Morgan Jay," an original YouTube series developed and produced by Austin-based creative agency Hello Party and financed by Live Nation Studios. The first episode, featuring "Saturday Night Live" cast member Kam Patterson, is streaming now on YouTube.

In each episode, Jay plays musical therapist to a celebrity guest, blending unscripted conversation and improv with live songwriting before the pair close with an original song they create together. The result lands somewhere between a talk show, a comedy special and a live concert.

Following Patterson, the season lineup includes comedian ASHBY (Nov. 25), rapper Yung Gravy (Dec 2.), "Dimension 20" game master Brennan Lee Mulligan, "Love on the Spectrum" star Abbey Romeo, actor and author Mara Wilson, comedian Mark Smalls, LA Chargers safety Tony Jefferson, impressionist Matt Friend and comedians Josh Johnson, Ron Funches and Mandal.

For Jay, the series is a natural extension of the comedic, musical voice he's built with his online audience, and the next step in his longtime partnership with Hello Party. "It's cool to finally get to a point in my career where I can make cool things with my friends that show who I am. And part of who I am is who I surround myself with," Jay said. "I couldn't be happier to work with Hello Party on this. We have such a great collaborative team, and I know we will make something new and unique in the space."

The series also marks a major expansion for Hello Party, the social-first agency founded in 2024 by creator and Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree Ty Stafford, as it moves beyond making content for brands and into original entertainment. "Music Therapy" grew out of Stafford and Jay's longtime creative partnership. The two first teamed up producing stand-up comedy shows that drew sponsorship from YouTube and moved into the YouTube Creator Space. Rather than build the series to a client brief, they developed the concept together and brought it to Live Nation Studios fully formed.

"The industry is changing, and agencies that want to stay relevant in the creator economy are going to have to pivot toward actually being creators," said Stafford, Hello Party's founder and CEO. "'Music Therapy' is proof that branded entertainment can start with a great idea and, with the right partners in place, become something audiences actually want to watch."

Live Nation Studios' support, which includes financing and access to its talent roster for guest appearances, reflects a broader shift in the creator economy as major entertainment companies invest directly in creator-led formats rather than treating creators solely as a marketing channel.

"We're so grateful Live Nation Studios got behind this," Stafford said. "Having a partner like that back an idea that started between two friends is a new kind of relationship, and it says everything about what creators can attract when they're genuinely out there making things. It's validating in the best way."

"At Live Nation Studios, we're always looking for new ways to bring music and comedy together, and 'Music Therapy' is exactly the kind of original, creator-driven content we're excited to branch into," said Ryan Kroft, Head of Film & Television at Live Nation Studios. "Morgan is a one-of-a-kind storyteller and partnering with him and Hello Party gives us an opportunity to bring that creativity to an even bigger audience as a digital series."

"Music Therapy with Morgan Jay" was created by Morgan Jay and Ty Stafford (Hello Party) and is directed by Stafford. Brooke Schley serves as showrunner and co-writes the series with Jay. Executive producers are Stafford, Graham Sicalowski, Robin Rapino, Stella Bulochnikov, Brooke Schley and Matt Sadeghian.

The "Music Therapy with Morgan jay" trailer premiered Nov. 17 at YouTube Creator Premieres in Los Angeles. Episode 1, featuring Kam Patterson, premieres Nov. 18 on Jay's YouTube channel, followed by episodes with Ashby on Nov. 25 and Yung Gravy on Dec. 2. New episodes drop every Wednesday, exclusively on YouTube. For more, follow @hellopartyagency on Instagram and @morganjay on TikTok, YouTube and Instagram.

About Morgan Jay

Morgan Jay is a Los Angeles-based musician and comedian whose work blends stand-up, music and storytelling. He has appeared on MTV's "Wild 'N Out," NBC and Comedy Central and was named a 2023 Just for Laughs New Face and one of Variety's "10 Comics to Watch" in 2025. Deadline also named Jay one of its "14 Comedians Who Won 2025."

A first-generation American, Jay draws musical influence from his Brazilian and Italian roots and his '90s upbringing. He began his career in New York City, attending NYU's Tisch School of the Arts while performing stand-up in the back rooms and bars of the city's alternative comedy scene.

As an actor, Jay stars alongside Chloë Grace Moretz and Anthony Ramos in Joey Power's feature "Love Language," which premiered at SXSW this year. He also appears in Apple TV+'s "Stick," opposite Owen Wilson and Marc Maron; NBC's "St. Denis Medical"; and Disney+'s "Wonder Man." Jay stars in J. Pinder's action-comedy "Cotton Candy Bubble Gum," which premiered in the Narrative Spotlight section at SXSW 2025, and will next appear opposite Pete Holmes in the indie feature "The Big Kill."

As a stand-up comedian, Jay has sold more than 350,000 tickets to headlining shows in more than 30 countries, establishing himself as one of the fastest-rising and most in-demand comedians working today. His second comedy special, "Live at the Village," is streaming on Hulu.

About Hello Party

Hello Party is a social creative agency founded on one principle: the people building your brand's social presence should live there. Founded in 2024 by creator and agency veteran Ty Stafford, one of YouTube's original creators and a Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree, the agency operates as a collective of practitioners who create, whether or not it's their job, serving clients including YouTube, Google Photos, Reddit, Red Bull and International Justice Mission. For more information, visit www.thisishelloparty.com or follow via Instagram and Facebook.

ABOUT LIVE NATION STUDIOS:

Live Nation Entertainment leads the industry in bringing artists and their live shows to stages worldwide. Live Nation Studios was created to help those artists tell their stories, building an Oscar-, Emmy- and Grammy-nominated film and television division focused on artist-driven films, television series and musically inspired stories for global audiences.

Recent Live Nation Studios projects include "Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience," which debuted as the No. 1 movie worldwide; Anderson .Paak's "K-Pops!," released theatrically as an AMC exclusive and Certified Fresh on Rotten Tomatoes; the documentary "Noah Kahan: Out of Body," a Netflix original and SXSW Audience Award winner; and the upcoming streaming premieres of the Green Day comedy "Nimrods" and "Rolling Loud: The Movie," starring Owen Wilson, Matt Rife and Travis Scott.

TRAVERSE CITY, Mich., Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hagerty won Best Journalism Film, one of seven nominations for the company at the 2026 International Motor Film Awards, held Nov. 14 at the Petersen Automotive Museum in Los Angeles. Hagerty has now taken home Best Journalism Film five years in a row through the continued creative delivery of Jason Cammisa and his video team.

2026 International Motor Film Awards Winner – Best Journalism Film

Hagerty's winning entry featured a fan-favorite three-car showdown viewed more than 2.8 million times on YouTube:

  • "Cammisa's Ultimate Lap Battle 2025" – Randy Pobst sets a new production-car lap record at Sonoma Raceway, and Cammisa details how it happened in a three-way battle between the 2026 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 (ZTK), the Ford Mustang GTD, and reigning champion, the 992.1 Porsche 911 GT3 RS. Directed by Anthony Esposito.

"Winning Best Journalism Film five years running says a lot about the dedication our team brings to creating great content for driving enthusiasts," said Marc Burns, Hagerty Chief Marketing Officer. "Our job is to give the audience something irresistible to watch when they can't be behind the wheel, and Cammisa's Ultimate Lap Battle does just that."

2026 International Motor Film Award Nominees

Hagerty also earned six nominations, five for Best Journalism Film and one for Best Documentary Short. The five other Hagerty films nominated for Best Journalism Film were "RetroSpective", hosted by Cammisa and directed by Esposito as well as "Prodrive 550: Driving the Last V12 Ferrari to Win at Le Mans", "HWA Evo: A Legend Reborn", "Ford Raptor T1+ Meets Ariel Nomad 2", and "Ferrari F355 Restomod by Evoluto", hosted by Henry Catchpole and filmed by Glenn Winhall. The Best Documentary Short nomination was for "Hagerty's 50 Years of the Porsche 911 Turbo" featuring Cammisa and Catchpole with production by Esposito and Robert Dalrymple.

The International Motor Film Awards honor the best in automotive film, television and photography, from YouTube productions to Hollywood features. Hagerty's win follows the four Gold Telly Awards the brand earned earlier this year for its Cammisa-hosted shows.

Hagerty makes it easier and more enjoyable to be a driving enthusiast, and award-winning content is central to that purpose. Across video, digital, print and audio, the brand is a trusted voice for the 67 million American car enthusiasts. The Hagerty Drivers Club is the largest car club in the world, with nearly 1 million members, and its magazine is the most popular car magazine in the world, with 2.2 million readers. Hagerty's original video programming, including Cammisa's "Icons," "Revelations" and "Ultimate" series and Catchpole's "The Driver's Seat," has earned nearly 1 billion views, with new episodes on the Hagerty YouTube channel and streaming on Prime Video, Samsung TV Plus and Tubi.

To see more award-winning films, visit www.youtube.com/hagerty, and to stay up to date with Hagerty, sign up for the Never Stop Driving newsletter at www.hagerty.com/media/newsletter.

Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers, protecting 3.1 million vehicles in the United States, Canada and the UK. We make it easier and more enjoyable for car enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love through innovative vehicle insurance products, live and digital auctions, engaging media and events and the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world's largest membership community of car lovers.

For more information, please visit www.hagerty.com or www.newsroom.hagerty.com. Never Stop Driving®.

releases.body:
An upcoming original EP and collection of musical experiences. More than music.

A message that lives on.

LOS ANGELES, Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- K & Co. Media announces the development of LEGACY, an upcoming original EP and collection of musical projects by singer-songwriter Katana Natasha. Extending beyond the album, LEGACY brings together creativity, connection and live experiences with a message of hope and lasting impact.

"Music has always been a part of my life, but now I'm stepping into an exciting new season, making more room to create, write and fully express myself as an artist," says Katana.

The vision for LEGACY began with a personal reflection as a mother: What would she leave behind for her children and the world around her? For Katana, the answer was music and faith.

Having grown up singing in church, leading worship and performing, Katana's artistic experience spans music, television and commercial projects. Throughout her life, she has always found her way back to the piano, finding peace in song and strength in her faith. It is where she is reminded of who she is and the rich heritage that has shaped her.

"I want to create music I am proud of, something my children and community can embrace and be inspired by. Songs that remind us of where we come from and continue to speak long after I'm gone."

Through LEGACY, Katana hopes to evoke emotion and encourage others to ask themselves:

What do you want to be known for? What will your legacy be?

LEGACY by Katana Natasha will encompass three signature projects:

  • The Album: A four-to-six-song inspirational EP featuring original music and showcasing Katana's distinctive vocal sound.
  • The Worship Experience: A professionally filmed, extended worship experience planned for YouTube, offering moments of reflection and renewal.
  • The Live Experience: An intimate, interactive album release event bringing together music, community and thought-provoking conversations.

Katana is also collaborating with film producers and directors on projects in development, writing original songs and music for upcoming productions.

Now, brands and individuals have the opportunity to become part of the making of LEGACY. K & Co. Media has created select brand partnerships and sponsorship opportunities designed to align participating brands with the project's message while showcasing them throughout the campaign. From the recording studio to the live stage, opportunities include strategic brand integration, media and publicity campaigns, social media promotion, behind-the-scenes content, digital storytelling and live-event engagement.

"LEGACY is about creating something meaningful that will outlast me. I want to be remembered for my music, for lifting others up and for making a positive difference in people's lives. Through the making of this album and the pursuit of my own musical dreams, I hope to inspire others to pursue theirs. Ultimately, I want this project to encourage all of us to reflect on how we're living, the impact we're making while alive and what we will leave behind."

Live with purpose. Leave a legacy.

releases.title: Warner Music Group CEO Robert Kyncl to Cover the Future of Music at CES 2027
releases.body:
Kyncl will preview music's next chapter of creation and interactivity in the first-ever official CES keynote by a music-company leader

ARLINGTON, Va., Nov. 18, 2026 /CNW/ -- The Consumer Technology Association (CTA)®, the owner and producer of CES®, welcomes Robert Kyncl, CEO of Warner Music Group (WMG), as a keynote speaker at CES 2027. Kyncl will deliver his keynote on Jan. 6 at 2 pm in the Palazzo Ballroom at the Venetian, becoming the first music-industry leader to keynote the world's most powerful tech event. This keynote signals the transformation of WMG into a cutting-edge company protecting and empowering artists and songwriters worldwide through a combination of proprietary, industry-leading technology and strategic partnerships with platforms launching AI-powered products that will allow fans to interact with music in new ways.

"CES is where industries come together to show how technology is shaping what's next," said Kinsey Fabrizio, President and CEO, CTA. "Music is such an important part of our culture and increasingly intersects with technology. I'm thrilled to welcome Robert Kyncl to the CES keynote stage to explore how innovation can create new opportunities for artists, creators and the industry while keeping human creativity at the center."  

WMG is a global music company bringing together artists, songwriters, entrepreneurs and technology to shape entertainment culture around the world. In 2026, TIME named Warner Music Group to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies list, recognizing its approach to AI and its work to ensure artists and songwriters are protected and can benefit as technology transforms the music industry.   

"We've been on the frontlines developing, licensing and embracing technology to power human artistry and expand opportunities for artists, songwriters and fans," said Kyncl. "CES is the epicenter of global innovation, and I'm excited to join the stage and share how we shape the future of music."

Throughout his career, Kyncl has helped drive some of the most significant shifts in the digital media landscape. Prior to joining WMG, he served as Chief Business Officer at YouTube, where he developed its creator ecosystem, as well as the rollout of its paid subscription services, including YouTube Premium, YouTube Music and YouTube TV. Earlier in his career, he spent seven years at Netflix, where helped pioneer the company's transition from DVD-by-mail to streaming film and TV content, playing a key role in its evolution into a global entertainment platform.

The keynote will be livestreamed on CES.tech, X, Facebook, YouTube and LinkedIn. 

Warner Music Group joins Lenovo, Stellantis, Waymo and WPP as part of the CES 2027 Keynote lineup. Registration for CES 2027 is open now. CES 2027 will take place January 6-9 in Las Vegas. Details and programming updates are available at CES.tech.

About CES®:  

CES is the most powerful tech event in the world – the proving ground for breakthrough technologies and global innovators. This is where the world's biggest brands do business and meet new partners, and the sharpest innovators hit the stage. Owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA)®, CES features every aspect of the tech sector. CES 2027 takes place Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas. Learn more at CES.tech and follow CES on social.

About Consumer Technology Association (CTA)®:  

As North America's largest technology trade association, CTA is the tech sector. Our members are the world's leading innovators – from startups to global brands – helping support more than 17 million American jobs. CTA owns and produces CES® – the most powerful tech event in the world. Find us at CTA.tech. Follow us @CTAtech.

 About Warner Music Group

 Warner Music Group (WMG) brings together artists, songwriters, entrepreneurs, and technology that are moving entertainment culture across the globe. WMG's Recorded Music division includes renowned labels such as 10K Projects, 300 Entertainment, Asylum, Atlantic, Big Beat, EastWest, Elektra, Erato, Fueled By Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Reprise, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Spinnin', Warner Records, Warner Classics, and Warner Records Nashville. WMG's music publishing arm, Warner Chappell Music, has a catalog of over one million copyrights spanning every musical genre, from the standards of the Great American Songbook to the biggest hits of the 21st century. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. Follow WMG on Instagram, X, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Facebook.

releases.title: Hershey's Celebrates Its Story with Five-Cent Milk Chocolate Bars Ahead of the HERSHEY Movie
releases.body:
One-day offer on Nov. 25 revives a nostalgic piece of Hershey's history, alongside a vintage-inspired packaging collection

HERSHEY, Pa., Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- For generations, Hershey's Milk Chocolate Bars have been part of the moments and memories people share. On Wednesday, Nov. 25, 2026, Hershey's is bringing back the bar's original five-cent price in celebration of HERSHEY, the upcoming movie that brings Milton and Catherine "Kitty" Hershey's story to a new generation.*

First introduced for five cents in 1900, the Hershey's Milk Chocolate Bar helped bring chocolate, once considered a luxury, within reach for more people. For one day only, a limited quantity will be available at that original price through select retailers and experiences, while supplies last, giving fans a sweet way to experience a piece of that history:

  • Hershey's Chocolate World: Visitors to the Hershey, Pa. and Times Square in New York, N.Y., locations can purchase a classic Hershey's Milk Chocolate Bar for five cents plus applicable tax during regular operating hours, beginning at 9 a.m. ET in Hershey and 10 a.m. ET in Times Square. Limit ten per person, while supplies last; no further discounts apply.
  • Walmart: Starting at 9 a.m. ET, shoppers can purchase a classic Hershey's Milk Chocolate Bar for five cents for online pickup when shopping at Walmart.com with a Walmart account. Fans shopping in store can also take advantage of the offer through the Ibotta app by purchasing a bar and uploading a photo of their receipt to receive cash back. Limit five per person, while supplies last; not available for Ship to Home; no further discounts apply.
  • Amazon: Starting at 9 a.m. ET, shoppers can purchase a classic Hershey's Milk Chocolate Bar for five cents from Amazon Grocery and get Same-Day Delivery for it (where available), including many major metropolitan areas like Philadelphia and Chicago. Fans can use the promotional code shared on Hershey's social media channels to receive free shipping at checkout for qualifying addresses only. Availability will depend on your delivery address. Tax is calculated based on the customers' total basket. Additional fees may apply for non-Prime members or expedited shipping. Limit two per person, while supplies last, quantities limited; no further discounts apply.

The special offer celebrates a memorable part of Hershey's history on the day the HERSHEY movie arrives in theaters nationwide.

"The five-cent bar gives fans a chance to experience a sweet piece of Hershey's story for themselves," said Samantha Siegal, Senior Marketing Director, The Hershey Company. "Bringing it back on the day HERSHEY debuts in theaters gives fans a fun way to celebrate the brand's roots and the story that inspired it."

A Familiar Brand Story, Rediscovered

Behind one of America's most iconic chocolate brands is a history more than a century in the making. Yet while the brand is familiar to millions, fewer know the story of chocolate pioneer Milton Hershey and his wife, Catherine "Kitty" Hershey, whose vision built a company, a community, and an enduring legacy.

In addition to the five-cent offer, Hershey's launched a limited-edition, vintage-inspired packaging collection that brings elements of the brand's history back to shelves this fall.

Inspired by some of Hershey's earliest packaging, the vintage-inspired collection brings archival details back to shelves, including a historic wordmark, Milton Hershey's signature, and period-inspired typography. An on-pack QR code also invites fans to learn more about the people, places, and ideas that helped shape Hershey's.

The packaging collection is available now for a limited time at participating retailers nationwide and shop.hersheys.com across a variety of Hershey's favorites, including Hershey's Milk Chocolate Bars and Hershey's Kisses chocolates, ahead of the HERSHEY movie debut in theaters nationwide on Nov. 25, 2026.

Fans can follow Hershey's on Instagram and TikTok for additional information.

*Available at select locations and through select retailers, while supplies last. Additional terms apply.

FAQs

How can fans get a classic Hershey's Milk Chocolate Bar for five cents?

For one day only on Nov. 25, a limited quantity of classic Hershey's Milk Chocolate Bars will be available for Hershey's original five-cent price through special offers from Walmart, Amazon, and Hershey's Chocolate World locations in Hershey, Pa. (9 a.m. ET) and Times Square in New York, N.Y. (10 a.m. ET).

At Walmart, beginning at 9 a.m. ET, fans can purchase the bar for five cents online at Walmart.com with a Walmart account or shop in store and access the offer through the Ibotta app by uploading a photo of their purchase receipt to receive cash back.

On Amazon.com, beginning at 9 a.m. ET, shoppers can purchase the bar for five cents from Amazon Grocery and get Same-Day Delivery for it (where available), including many major metropolitan areas like Philadelphia and Chicago. Fans can use the promotional code shared on Hershey's social media channels to receive free shipping at checkout for qualifying addresses only. Availability will depend on your delivery address. Tax is calculated based on the customers' total basket. Additional fees may apply for non-Prime members or expedited shipping. Limit two per person, while supplies last, quantities limited; no further discounts apply.

At Hershey's Chocolate World, guests can purchase the bar for five cents plus applicable tax during regular operating hours. The offer begins at 9 a.m. ET at the Hershey, Pa., location and 10 a.m. ET at the Times Square location.

Offers are available while supplies last, with a limit of five bars per person through Walmart, two bars per person at Amazon, and ten bars per person at Hershey's Chocolate World. No further discounts apply.

Is the five-cent offer part of the Hershey's vintage-inspired collection?

The five-cent offer is on classic Hershey's Milk Chocolate Bars, not bars featuring the vintage-inspired packaging. It is a special one-day celebration tied to Hershey's history and the HERSHEY movie debut. The broader Hershey's vintage-inspired collection is available separately at participating retailers nationwide and shop.hersheys.com for a limited time.

What is Hershey's vintage-inspired collection? Which products are included?

Hershey's vintage-inspired collection is a limited-edition collection, featuring vintage-inspired packaging across Hershey's favorites. Inspired by some of Hershey's earliest packaging, the designs bring archival details back to shelves, including a historic wordmark, Milton Hershey's signature, and period-inspired typography.

The Hershey's vintage-inspired collection includes Hershey's Milk Chocolate Bars (Standard Bar, King Size Bar, XL Bar, Giant Bar, 10.35-ounce Snack Size Pouch) and Hershey's Kisses chocolates (9.5-ounce Hershey's Kisses Pouch, 30-ounce Hershey's Kisses Pouch).

When and where will the Hershey's vintage-inspired collection be available?

The Hershey's vintage-inspired collection is available now for a limited time at participating retailers nationwide and shop.hersheys.com. Pricing is at the sole discretion of the retailer.

How is Hershey's vintage-inspired collection connected to the HERSHEY Movie?

The Hershey's vintage-inspired collection is inspired by the story featured in HERSHEY, the upcoming movie about chocolate pioneer Milton Hershey and Catherine "Kitty" Hershey. The movie debuts in theaters nationwide on Nov. 25, 2026.

Where can fans find updates about Hershey's vintage-inspired collection?

Fans can follow Hershey's on Instagram and TikTok for additional information.

What is the HERSHEY Movie about?

The HERSHEY movie tells the story of Milton Hershey and Catherine "Kitty" Hershey. It follows Milton Hershey's work as a confectioner and the growth of his chocolate business. The film also shows the Hershey's' decision to create a home and school for children, seeking greater opportunity, and the events that led them to place their fortune in its care.

What role does Angel play in the HERSHEY movie?

Angel is the movie's theatrical distributor. It is responsible for releasing HERSHEY in theaters and supporting the movie's marketing and publicity. Angel did not write, produce, or direct the movie.

Where can I learn more about the HERSHEY movie?

HERSHEY is a Major Motion Picture informed by real people, events, and places. For more about the movie, the historical research behind it, and how documented events were adapted for the screen, visit HersheyLegacy.org.

About The Hershey Company

The Hershey Company (NYSE: HSY) is an industry-leading snacks company with a purpose to make more moments of goodness and a vision to lead next generation snacking. Hershey brings together more than 20,000 employees worldwide to deliver delicious, high-quality products across more than 85 brands in approximately 65 countries, generating more than $11.7 billion in annual revenues.

Hershey brings its full portfolio to market as ONE Hershey, spanning confection, salty, and functional snacking categories with beloved brands like Hershey's, Reese's, Kisses, KIT KAT®, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers and Ice Breakers; salty snacks including SkinnyPop, LesserEvil, Pirate's Booty and Dot's Homestyle Pretzels; and a protein portfolio including ONE Brands and Fulfil.

For more than 130 years, Hershey has operated fairly, ethically, and sustainably. Founder Milton Hershey established Milton Hershey School in 1909, and that legacy of purpose endures today through the company's commitment to helping children succeed through equitable access to education.

To learn more visit www.thehersheycompany.com.

releases.body:
First senior appointment by Felipe Holguin, Meyer brings deep creative experience and wide-ranging relationships across Latin music's artist community

SANTA MONICA, Calif., Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Universal Music Group (UMG), the world leader in music-based entertainment, today announced the appointment of Ignacio Meyer as President of Universal Music Latin America & Iberian Peninsula, effective immediately. Meyer will report to Felipe Holguin, who was named CEO of the division yesterday.

Meyer will bring his wide-ranging experience in creative strategy and artist development, along with his relationships throughout the creative community, to UMG's operations across Latin America and Iberia. Working with Holguin and UMG's local and global teams, he will draw on their complementary expertise and shared spirit of innovation to find new ways to support artists and connect their music with audiences around the world.

Holguin said: "Artists are at the heart of how we're building this next chapter. Nacho combines creative sensibility and strategic vision with a deep understanding of how to nurture each artist's individuality, grow their audience, and heighten their impact across platforms. He'll add a powerful dimension to our leadership team as we invest in extraordinary artists and bring bold ideas to life. We know from experience how well we work together, and I'm delighted to welcome him to UMG."

Meyer said: "Latin music is shaping culture around the world because its artists keep pushing boundaries by embracing new sounds, new technologies, and new ways to connect with fans. Their creative ambition is a force for the entire industry. Our role is to amplify that vision with the right support, fresh thinking, and UMG's global reach. I'm excited to work with Felipe and our teams to help artists build lasting careers and take their music even further."

Meyer has held leadership roles at TelevisaUnivision since 2011, spanning US networks and local media, radio, music and non-scripted entertainment, business development, and strategic partnerships. Most recently, as President, U.S. Networks & Local Media, he led the business as Univision reclaimed its position as the No. 1 Spanish-language network in the United States and delivered the highest rated music award shows in the US amongst Hispanic audiences.

As Executive Vice President, Music & Non-Scripted Entertainment, Meyer oversaw Univision's music business, cross-platform programming strategy and major live events, including the executive production of award-winning shows such as Premio Lo Nuestro, Premios Juventud, and the Latin GRAMMY Awards. His responsibilities also included artist-development efforts in the U.S. and globally, as well as strategic business development initiatives across music, music publishing, and sound design. He also led franchise development and corporate partnerships, direct-to-consumer initiatives, experiential marketing, and licensing. During his Univision tenure, Uforia launched U-LAB, a program that paired emerging artists with artistic mentorship and digital distribution.

Before joining Univision, Meyer founded and served as Managing Partner of strategic advisory firm Konexxion Enterprises. Earlier in his career, he began working with artists directly as a manager, served on the management team of IFPI Latin America (an industry body representing 1500+ recorded music companies), and helped establish The Latin Recording Academy as an independent organization dedicated to advancing Latin music and its creators around the world.

Committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship, UMG fosters the development of services, platforms and business models in order to broaden artistic and commercial opportunities for our artists and create new experiences for fans. releases.title: KUDDZOO Officially Launches the Creator-First App Where Fans Back the Creators They Believe In and Brings Music Business Heavy Hitters Into Its Leadership
releases.body:
NASHVILLE, Tenn., Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- KUDDZOO, the creator-first app where fans back the creators they believe in, officially launched today along with its own label, KUDDZOO Records. Co-founders Kurt Ravenstein, Jon Townsend, Nikia Shanard and Chantal Reeder are joined by David Fritz of Boyarski Fritz LLP as outside counsel and longtime music executive Issy Sanchez as Chief Creative Officer of KUDDZOO Records.

KUDDZOO is a full ecosystem where creators stream, post and build community, and where fans do more than follow. There's no algorithm deciding who gets seen. Fans back the creators they believe in with $1 a month that goes to the creator they choose, and daily rankings built on real activity spotlight the top creators for streams, posts and backers. The name is a nod to kudzu, the vine that grows faster than anything around it.

"KUDDZOO was created as a platform for all creators to be seen and heard. It's a place where anyone can play without the game being tilted against them by anyone, including an algorithm. It doesn't matter if you're in Music City, LA or the panhandle of Oklahoma. It doesn't matter if you're signed to a label, an independent artist or just trying to build your career. If you're a creator who can get 1,000 fans to subscribe to you, we want to help you turn that into real, recurring income," said Kurt Ravenstein, co-founder, President and CEO of KUDDZOO. "I'm honored to have an incredible team that shares a passion for uplifting artists and creators. Having David and Issy on the team, people who have looked out for artists their entire careers at the highest level, is humbling, and it represents what we're doing for creators in the entertainment industry."

Ravenstein has spent 30 years building and disrupting businesses, from leaving a fifth-generation family farm and ranch to start his own management company at 25, to helping own and operate more than 50 senior living properties nationwide and turning around companies across healthcare, construction and insurance. Today he runs the Nashville-based music label Raven Entertainment and, with his partner, fashion designer Dara, leads the acclaimed design brand La Dara, whose custom pieces have been worn by Kid Rock, Carrie Underwood, Miranda Lambert and Tim McGraw.

Chief Operating Officer and General Counsel Jon Townsend is an attorney and entrepreneur with more than 12 years structuring businesses and protecting ownership. A songwriter with roots in music and ministry leadership, he brings a creative eye to the legal side.

Chief Brand Officer Nikia Shanard came up on Uptown Records' street promotion team and has spent 30 years building brands across music and fashion. He founded the creative and marketing company Toil & Leisure and NiVe Entertainment Group, which gives independent artists label-level support while they keep ownership of their work.

releases.title: Milton Hershey School Hosts Exclusive HERSHEY Movie Premiere
releases.body:
Founders Week Event Offers Students a First Look at the Film Through a Gold-Carpet Premiere Featuring Surprise Hollywood Guests, Immersive Exhibits, and Historic Artifacts

HERSHEY, Pa., Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Milton Hershey School (MHS) students became the first large audience to watch the HERSHEY movie during an exclusive premiere at Founders Hall on Sunday, Nov. 15. The milestone screening placed the students who carry Milton and Catherine Hershey's legacy forward at the center of a one-of-a-kind event that concluded the school's 2026 Founders Week.

"Our students are the Hersheys' heirs and the living embodiment of Milton and Catherine's dream."

"Our students were not simply invited to see the HERSHEY movie. They were given the distinction of experiencing it first," said MHS President Peter G. Gurt. "That made the premiere especially meaningful because our students are the Hersheys' heirs and the living embodiment of Milton and Catherine's dream. There could be no more fitting audience with whom to share this story."

The premiere transformed the MHS campus into a movie extravaganza designed specifically for students. They walked a 739-foot gold carpet reflecting one of the school's signature colors, explored immersive exhibits about Milton and Catherine Hershey's lives and contributions, viewed rarely shown artifacts and costumes from the film, and took part in a custom-designed LED floor activation connected to the MHS Alma Mater. The event also featured appearances by influencers, celebrities, and actors, including Alexandra Daddario and Candace Cameron Bure, before students gathered for the screening.

The premiere capped a weeklong celebration rooted in the Hersheys' signing of the Deed of Trust in 1909 that established the school. Founders Week also included a special chapel service; a tree-planting ceremony for high school seniors; Founders Feast, a meal of gratitude served by MHS staff to all 2,200 students; a Founders Day Assembly and parade; fireworks above Founders Hall; and a Student Government Association Leadership Conference featuring Hershey entity executives.

"Being at Milton Hershey School and seeing firsthand the impact that Milton and Catherine Hershey's vision continues to have on young people is incredibly moving," said Daddario, who portrays Catherine Hershey in the HERSHEY film. "MHS is an amazing home and school for children and brings to life the very best of the Hersheys' ever-inspiring influence on the world."

Founded 117 years ago, MHS has a mission to nurture and educate children in social and financial need to lead fulfilling and productive lives. Honoring the Hersheys' wishes, its students live on campus in family-style homes led by married houseparent couples. Because of the Hersheys' incredible generosity, no student ever pays to attend, and all costs—including healthcare, food, clothing, activities, and more—are fully covered.

"At MHS, we are forever grateful for our founders, and we will never take lightly our responsibility to make them proud in how we live, learn, and serve," said Gurt.

ABOUT MILTON HERSHEY SCHOOL

Milton Hershey School is one of the world's best private schools, where qualifying students in pre-kindergarten through 12th grade live on campus and receive an exceptional educational experience—with all costs covered. For more information, visit mhskids.org.

releases.body:
Based on an Extraordinary True Story of Faith, Family and the Power of Prayer, the Film Stars Ashley Greene, Russell Quinn, Elizabeth Tabish, Andy Buckley and More

Watch the One in a Million Teaser Trailer Here

DENVER, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- EKKL Entertainment and Fathom Entertainment, the leading specialty distributor of content to theatrical partners worldwide, today announced they will bring One in a Million, a faith-based drama inspired by the true story of a family's fight to save their son's life, to movie theatres nationwide beginning March 5, 2027.

Based on the remarkable true story of the Kassis family, One in a Million follows two parents whose faith is tested as they fight to save their young son's life. Facing unimaginable circumstances, the family draws strength from their faith and the support of a community united in hope for a miracle.

One in a Million stars Ashley Greene (The Twilight Saga), Russell Quinn ("CSI: NY"), Elizabeth Tabish ("The Chosen"), Andy Buckley ("The Office," Jurassic World), Ashley Bratcher (Unplanned), Kensington Tallman (Inside Out 2), Grace Byers ("Empire"), Rob Morgan ("Chicago Fire"), and Lou Diamond Phillips (Stand and Deliver) with Wayne Knight ("Seinfeld," Jurassic Park) and introducing Roxton Garcia.

At a Dallas hospital, doctors diagnose the Kassis family's son, Jade, with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH), a rare, life-threatening disorder, following a sudden and unexplained illness. As the family waits to learn whether treatment will work, Jade's mother searches for answers while their community rallies around them in prayer. After weeks of uncertainty, an extraordinary outcome unfolds.

"EKKL is honored to partner with the Kassis family to help bring their miraculous story to the big screen," said Dave Mechem, Head of Acquisitions at EKKL Entertainment. "One In A Million is a powerful testimony of faith and perseverance, reminding us that even in the darkest times, we can hold fast to the promises of God and find our hope in Jesus."

One in a Million was written by Tanner Beard and Cindy Kassis, based on her journals, and directed by Beard. The film's producers are Tomik Mansoori (Fluxx), Xander McCabe (The Other), Tiffany FitzHenry (Mary), and Cindy and Nadeem Kassis.

Tickets for One in a Million will be available beginning January 29, 2027, online at Fathom Entertainment and participating theatre box offices (theatre locations are subject to change). For more information, visit Fathom Entertainment.

Follow One in a Million on Facebook, Instagram and TikTok at @oneinamillionmovie or visit oneinamillionmovie.com.
