releases.title: FELIPE HOLGUIN APPOINTED CEO OF UNIVERSAL MUSIC LATIN AMERICA & IBERIAN PENINSULA
releases.body:
Experienced media & music executive and entrepreneur to lead UMG's Latin operations, building on the region's global momentum and deepening the company's commitment to artists

 

SANTA MONICA, Calif., Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Universal Music Group (UMG), the world leader in music-based entertainment, today announced the appointment of Felipe Holguin as CEO of Universal Music Latin America & Iberian Peninsula, effective immediately. He will report to Sir Lucian Grainge, Chairman and CEO of UMG.

A versatile executive and entrepreneur with more than thirty years of experience across music, media, technology, and finance in the U.S., Latin America, and Europe, Holguin has built creative businesses, led digital organizations, and helped drive strategy and M&A across the region.

Holguin will lead UMG's Latin music operations across the U.S., Latin America, and Iberia. Working with the company's local and global teams, he will help identify and develop the next generation of talent, support artists at every stage of their careers, amplify the region's diverse music and cultures, and bring UMG's deep catalog to new generations of listeners around the world.

The appointment follows Jesús López's decision to take on a new role as Chairman Emeritus of Global Talent Services, the artist management and services company he conceived. UMG and its artists will continue to benefit from his wide-ranging expertise, relationships, and insight into the business.

Sir Lucian Grainge, Chairman and CEO of UMG, said: "Latin music has led the way in opening global audiences to artists around the world, showing how music can cross borders while staying rooted in the cultures that give it life. Its many voices and sounds continue to expand what's possible and point toward what's next. Felipe combines deep respect for artistry and the Latin creative ecosystem with expertise across business, technology, and data. I'm excited to see him work with our teams to invest in the extraordinary and the unexpected and to create more global opportunities for artists."

Holguin said: "Artists are the ultimate change agents. Our role is to bring together the ideas, platforms, and partnerships that help them reach fans and move culture forward. Jesús and the talented people across Latin America and Iberia have helped shape Latin music's global rise. I'm excited to work with UMG's teams across the globe to build our company around artists and help their music travel even further."

Jesús López said: "I'm proud to welcome Felipe to UMG. He's an accomplished leader with a clear vision for the future, and I'm confident he'll build on the extraordinary foundation our teams have created. I look forward to supporting the company as we continue our shared mission of helping artists realize the full scope of their ambitions."

At Univision Communications, Holguin served as CEO of Fusion Media Group, where he transformed operations, integrated digital acquisitions, and grew the company's English-language division to 92 million monthly unique visitors, at the time the largest digital publisher in its competitive set. He also served as Executive Vice President of Digital, News and Music at Univision, leading strategy, operations, and M&A across Univision.com, including its music streaming and audio platform and televised music award-show franchises. Earlier in his career, Holguin co-founded Page One Media, publisher of PODER, a business magazine for Hispanic leaders in the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Peru, and Chile. The company was sold to Televisa.

Most recently, Holguin worked with HYBE Latin America on strategy and operations. He previously worked with Exile Content Studio on the launch, growth, and sale of its music business to HYBE, as well as on the company's strategy and development, including its acquisition by Candle Media.

Holguin holds an MBA from Harvard Business School and dual engineering degrees from Worcester Polytechnic Institute.

NEW YORK, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- There's nothing quite like live music. The crowd's energy. The artist-fan connection. But after the lights come up, too much of that togetherness gets lost. As AI reshapes music, human connection matters more than ever.

Yet the live music experience is fragmented across ticketing, social and commerce platforms, leaving fans with disconnected experiences and artists struggling to capture the value created at every show. Today, Groovon launched its Always-On Live Music Network, unifying the live music experience through five interconnected pillars, creating a fairer model for artists and a more rewarding experience for fans.

Turning Every Show into Lasting Value

At the heart of Groovon is Live Connect, transforming every show into an immersive, interactive digital experience. Fans interact with artists and fans, and share Live Moments. Artists acquire and know fans, build communities, sell merchandise and exclusive experiences, receive tips and turn fan-created content into marketing assets.

Where Discovery & Booking Take You Further

From concerts to underground gems, Groovon offers one of the richest live music discovery systems, covering 35,000 monthly shows. Integrating with 12 ticketing platforms, including Ticketmaster and DICE, and using technology to uncover underground venues, Groovon takes fans beyond tickets to the complete live music experience, while giving artists fair, organic exposure.

Music's Own Organic Social Network

Unlike today's social networks that restrict organic reach and discovery, forcing artists to pay to reach followers, Groovon offers 100% organic reach and discovery without pay-to-boost barriers. Artist Communities let musicians engage fans, share music and promote shows. Fan Pages let fans share experiences, meet like-minded music lovers and build relationships around their favourite artists.

Artist Commerce

Groovon integrates Direct-to-Fan Commerce across live music and beyond, enabling artists to monetize existing fan relationships without acquiring separate audiences. Through Offer Design Studio, artists create exclusive experiences, from name mentions and backstage tours to after-show hangouts.

Rewarding Fans

Fans earn Fan Points for spending and participation, progress through four Fan Tiers from Rising Fans to Superfans, and build artist-specific Fan Rank. Groovon funds and manages rewards on behalf of artists.

A single, persistent fan identity unifies the live music experience.

"The center of gravity in music is shifting toward live, yet the live music experience remains fragmented," said Subhra Das, Founder and CEO of Groovon. "We're building the digital infrastructure to unify the live music ecosystem, creating a fairer model for artists and a more rewarding experience for fans."

releases.title: DUETTI SECURES $665M IN NEW FUNDING TO ACCELERATE INVESTMENT INTO INDEPENDENT MUSIC CATALOGS
releases.body:
Duetti has now raised over $1.3 billion since inception in 2022, including three asset-backed securitizations in two years

NEW YORK , Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Duetti Inc. ("Duetti" or the "Company"), the music company that partners with independent artists, songwriters, and producers to buy, manage, and market their catalogs, announces that it has secured $665 million in additional capital. The financing package includes a $450 million asset-backed securitization (ABS) anchored by global investment firm Carlyle, alongside $165 million of additional credit capacity provided by Viola Credit and a $50 million side facility with Flexpoint Ford and Truist Bank. 

Since its establishment in 2022, Duetti has completed more than 1,600 catalog investments, and currently owns a highly diversified music catalog across over 50,000 masters and compositions, representing the works of over 3,000 recording artists. To date, Duetti has partnered with artists, songwriters and other rights owners from over 50 countries. The Company will use the new capital to significantly accelerate the pace and breadth of its investment activities across genres and geographies, as well as different types of music rights. 

"This funding marks a significant milestone for Duetti, firmly placing us among a distinguished group of music rights platforms operating at real scale, which allows us to unlock substantial benefits in terms of market intelligence and operating capabilities," said Lior Tibon, CEO and Co-Founder of Duetti. "Our third ABS transaction in just two years is more than five times the size of our inaugural deal in 2024, demonstrating our rapid growth, strong track record and increasing institutional demand for our catalog and business model." 

"We anchored this securitization because independent music royalties can generate the kind of recurring, diversified cash flows that asset-backed finance is built around," said Akhil Bansal, Head of Asset-Backed Finance at Carlyle. "Duetti pairs real industry expertise with the data and technology to build and manage catalogs at scale, and that's what gives us conviction in the platform."

"Duetti's inaugural ABS transaction in 2024 helped pioneer securitization backed primarily by independent music catalogs, and the Company has since become a repeat issuer in the ABS market," said Salina Sabri, Managing Director at Barclays. "This latest transaction achieved a ratings upgrade and was placed with a broader group of institutional investors than the Company's prior issuances, marking the continued expansion of its ABS program and investor base."

Duetti currently has over 110 full-time team members worldwide and continues to expand at pace in response to the demand from its creator audience. Over the past 12 months, it has opened offices in Nashville, Paris and Rio de Janeiro, in addition to its existing footprint in New York City, Los Angeles, Miami and London. The Company continues to invest in proprietary technology, data infrastructure and operational capabilities to originate, acquire and manage music catalogs. Duetti has also developed a growing range of value-add catalog management and marketing programs, including royalty optimization, playlisting, remixes and other music audience development initiatives. 

The investment is being led by Carlyle's Asset-Backed Finance (ABF) team within its Global Credit platform. Carlyle brings to the partnership the ability to structure bespoke financial solutions for partners and artists. Since 2017, Carlyle has deployed more than $17 billion of capital into the sports, media, and entertainment sectors.

releases.title: UNIVERSAL MUSIC GROUP'S FAMILY OF ARTISTS, SONGWRITERS, LABELS AND DISTRIBUTED PARTNERS NOMINATED ACROSS ALL GENRES FOR THE 69TH ANNUAL GRAMMY AWARDS
releases.body:
Olivia Rodrigo (Interscope) and Miranda Lambert (MCA) lead UMG recording artists with seven nominations apiece, followed by Olivia Dean (Capitol Records UK/Island) with six

ROSALÍA leads UMPG's songwriter nominations with nine

SANTA MONICA, Calif., Nov. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Universal Music Group (UMG), the world leader in music-based entertainment, and its family of recording artists, songwriters, labels and distributed partners today received nominations for the 69th Annual Grammy Awards spanning every genre.

UMG recording artist Olivia Rodrigo (Interscope) received seven nominations, including Record Of The Year, Song Of The Year and Best Pop Solo Performance for "the cure," and Album Of The Year and Best Pop Vocal Album for you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love; plus, Best Rock Performance and Best Rock Song for "what's wrong with me," featuring Robert Smith of The Cure (Fiction/Capitol).

Miranda Lambert (MCA) also received seven nominations across a broad range of categories including Record Of The Year, Album Of The Year, Song Of The Year, Best Country Song and Producer Of The Year, Non-Classical for her work with Ella Langley. She also received a Best Country Song nomination for her collaboration with Stephen Wilson Jr. (Big Loud/Mercury Records) on "Hardwired" and a Best Country Duo/Group Performance nomination for "Horses & Divorces" with Kacey Musgraves (Lost Highway)

UMPG songwriter ROSALÍA received nine nominations, including Record Of The Year and Song Of The Year for "Berghain" and Album Of The Year and Best Alternative Music Album for LUX (Complete Works). She also earned Best Pop Solo Performance for "Sauvignon Blanc," Best Alternative Music Performance for "Relíquia," Best Music Video for "Berghain," Best Latin Song for "La Perla" and Best Global Music Performance for "Porcelana."

UMPG songwriters are represented across four of the eight Song Of The Year nominees: "Berghain" (co-written by ROSALÍA), "hate that i made you love me" (Ariana Grande), "Man I Need" (Tobias Jesso Jr.) and "I Knew It, I Knew You" (Taylor Swift and Jack Antonoff). UMPG songwriters, artists and producers are also credited on four of the eight Album Of The Year nominees and three of the eight Record Of The Year nominees.

In the prestigious Best New Artist category, SIENNA SPIRO (Capitol Records), Remi Wolf (Island) and Geese  (Partisan via VMG/PIAS/UMPG) are all nominated. Additionally, Geese were nominated for Best Alternative Music Album for Getting Killed, Best Rock Performance and Best Rock Song for "Trinidad," and Best Alternative Music Performance for "Au Pays du Cocaine."

Following her Best New Artist win in 2026, Olivia Dean (Capitol Records UK/Island) received six nominations, including Record Of The Year and Song Of The Year for "Man I Need"; Album Of The Year and Best Pop Vocal Album for The Art of Loving; Best Pop Solo Performance for "Man I Need"; and Best Traditional Pop Vocal Performance for "A Couple Minutes."

Leon Thomas (Motown/Capitol) received six nominations: Best Progressive R&B Album for PHOLKS; Best Traditional R&B Performance and Best R&B Song for "My Muse"; Best Melodic Rap Performance for "Watching Us" with Wale (Def Jam); and two Best R&B Collaboration or Duo/Group Performance nominations for his featured performances on "Fallin'" with Chris Brown and "Sweet Nuthins" with Kehlani.

Taylor Swift (Republic Records/UMPG) received five nominations, including Record Of The Year for "The Fate of Ophelia," Album Of The Year for The Life of a Showgirl and Song Of The Year for "I Knew It, I Knew You." With The Life of a Showgirl, she extends her run to five consecutive Album Of The Year nominations, joining Kendrick Lamar as the only artists to do so, while she remains the only artist with four wins in the Album of the Year category.

Ariana Grande (Republic Records/UMPG) earned four nominations: Song Of The Year for "hate that i made you love me"; Best Pop Vocal Album for petal; Best Traditional Pop Vocal Performance for "For Good"; and Best Music Video for "hate that i made you love me."

Jon Batiste (Verve Label Group) received four: Best Jazz Performance for "In Walked Bud"; Best Jazz Instrumental Album for Monk Movements; Best Contemporary Instrumental Album for Monk Meditations; and Best Classical Compendium for Black Mozart.

Brandi Carlile (Lost Highway/UMPG) is nominated for Best American Roots Performance for "You Without Me"; Best Americana Performance, Best American Roots Song and Best Americana Album for Returning To Myself.

Doechii (Capitol Records/TDE/UMPG) earned four nominations: Best Pop Duo/Group Performance and Best Song Written For Visual Media for "RUNWAY," alongside Lady Gaga (Interscope), and Best Melodic Rap Performance and Best Rap Song for "girl, get up." featuring SZA (UMPG).

Kacey Musgraves (Lost Highway) received four nominations: Best Contemporary Country Album for Middle of Nowhere, Best Country Solo Performance and Best Country Song for "Dry Spell" and Best Country Duo/Group Performance with Miranda Lambert (MCA) for "Horses & Divorces."

In the rock categories, The Rolling Stones (Polydor/UMG) earned three nominations: Best Rock Performance and Best Rock Song for "In The Stars," and Best Rock Album for Foreign Tongues. YUNGBLUD (Capitol Records) & Aerosmith are also nominated for Best Rock Song for "My Only Angel." Paul McCartney (Capitol Records) is nominated for Best Traditional Pop Vocal Album for The Boys of Dungeon Lane, Best Audio Book, Narration, and Storytelling Recording for The Man on the Run, and Best Music Film for Man on the Run.

Elsewhere, Nine Inch Nails (Interscope) were nominated for Best Engineered Album, Non-Classical for Nine Inch Noize, and also received a Best Remixed Recording nomination for "A Question of Trust — Boys Noize Remix." BABYMETAL (Capitol Records) is nominated for Best Asian Pop Music Performance for "Sunset Kiss" featuring Polyphia.

Across the Latin categories, Juanes (Universal Music Latino) is nominated for Best Latin Rock or Alternative Album with JuanesTeban. In Best Latin Pop Album, both Karol G (Interscope Records) for NO ME ARREPIENTO DE SENTIR TANTO and Carín León (Island Records/VMG) for MUDA were nominated. Álvaro Díaz (Universal Music Latino), Feid (Universal Music Latino), Young Miko (The Wave Music Group via VMG) and J Balvin (Capitol Records) and Ryan Castro earned Best Música Urbana Album nominations for OMAKASE, EL GREEN PRINT: La Saga (Disc 1) — FEID VS FERXXO, Do Not Disturb: Late Checkout and Omerta, respectively. Rubén Blades, Roberto Delgado & Orquesta (Rubén Blades via VMG) are nominated for Best Tropical Latin Album with País Portátil, while Anitta (UMLE/Republic Records) is nominated for Best Global Music Album with EQUILIBRIVM.

Across the Rap/Hip-Hop and R&B categories, Wale earned two nominations for Best Rap Album Everything Is A Lot, and Best Melodic Rap Performance for his song "Watching Us" (featuring Leon Thomas). Yung Miami (Uptown/Republic Records) is nominated for Best Rap Song for "Spend Dat"; JID (Dreamville/Interscope Records) is featured on "To B Honest" (Best R&B Collaboration or Duo/Group Performance); and Kendrick Lamar (Interscope Records) appears on "Good Flirts" (Best Rap Performance). In the Best Rap Album category, Rapsody (We Each Other/Roc Nation Records) is nominated for God Gotta Afro & Gold Hoops.

Across the visual media categories, Paul McCartney's Man on the Run (Polygram Entertainment) is nominated for Best Music Film; while its companion audiobook is nominated for Best Audio Book, Narration, and Storytelling Recording. Billie Eilish (Interscope/UMPG) is also nominated for Best Music Film for Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour Live.

Taylor Swift's "I Knew It, I Knew You" (Republic Records) from Toy Story 5 is nominated for both Song Of The Year and Best Song Written For Visual Media. Wicked: For Good (Verve Label Group/Republic Records) is nominated for Best Compilation Soundtrack For Visual Media; "For Good," performed by Cynthia Erivo (Verve Label Group/Republic Records) and Ariana Grande (Republic Records), is nominated for Best Traditional Pop Vocal Performance, and "No Place Like Home" for Best Song Written For Visual Media.

UMG's visual-media nominations also include The Devil Wears Prada 2 (Interscope) for Best Compilation Soundtrack For Visual Media, Ludwig Göransson's score for Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu (Walt Disney Records) for Best Score Soundtrack For Visual Media, and David Fleming's Marvel's Wolverine (Hollywood Records/Marvel Music) and Gordy Haab's Star Wars: Zero Company (Walt Disney Records/Hollywood Records) for Best Score Soundtrack For Video Games and Other Interactive Media.

Classical nominations include Jon Batiste's (Verve Label Group) Black Mozart for Best Classical Compendium, Anthony Hopkins (Decca Classics) for Hopkins: My Fatherland  in Best Choral Performance, while in the Jazz and blues, Melissa Aldana (Blue Note Records) for Best Latin Jazz Album with Filin, DOMi & JD Beck (Blue Note Records) for Best Alternative Jazz Album with WHO ASKED? and Morgan Freeman (Decca Records) for Best Traditional Blues Album with Symphonic Blues Experience.

In Contemporary Christian Music, Jamie MacDonald (Capitol Christian Music Group/UMPG) is nominated for Best Contemporary Christian Music Performance/Song for "Left It In The River" and Best Contemporary Christian Music Album for her self-titled album. Tauren Wells (Capitol Christian Music Group) is also nominated in the album category for Breathe On It.

The GRAMMYs also recognized UMG's family of artists and distributed partners in album categories across genres. Additional nominees included:

Best Alternative Music Album: Alabama Shakes (Island Records) for I Must Be Dreaming.

Best Progressive R&B Album: Tank and the Bangas (Verve Label Group) for The Last Balloon.

Best Traditional Country Album: Vince Gill (MCA) for 50 Years From Home: Down At The Borderline.

Best Contemporary Country Album: Carter Faith (Gatsby Records/MCA) for Cherry Valley.

Best Contemporary Folk Album: Noah Kahan (Mercury Records) for The Great Divide: The Last Of The Bugs, Madison Cunningham (Verve Label Group) for Ace.

Best Traditional Pop Vocal Album: Sarah McLachlan (Concord Records) for Better Broken.

Best Americana Album: Tedeschi Trucks Band (Fantasy Records/Concord) for Future Soul.

Best Jazz Instrumental Album: Pat Metheny (Green Hill Productions via VMG) for Side-Eye III+, Sullivan Fortner (Artwork via Virgin Music Group/VMG) for Leave That In There, Lakecia Benjamin (Artwork via VMG) for We Dream.

Best Alternative Jazz Album: Fathers (Blue Note Records) for Fathers.

Best Traditional Blues Album: Joe Bonamassa (KTBA Records via VMG) for B.B. King's Blues Summit 100.

Best Contemporary Blues Album: Samantha Fish (Rounder Records/Concord) for Paper Doll (Live), Ruthie Foster (Sun Records via VMG) for Just Say Yes, Keb' Mo' (Concord Records) for The Breakdown.

Best Contemporary Christian Music Album: Israel & New Breed (Integrity via VMG) for Coritos Vol. 2.

Best Musical Theater Album: Ragtime — 2025 Broadway Cast Recording (Concord Theatricals Recordings).

Best Global Music Album: Ayra Starr (Mavin/Republic Records) for Starrgirl.

Best New Age, Ambient, or Chant Album: Brian Eno & Beatie Wolfe (Verve Label Group) for Liminal, Vicente Avella (CD Baby via Downtown/VMG) for Night Music.

Best Gospel Album: Jonathan McReynolds (Motown Gospel) for Closer (Live In Chicago).

Best Children's Music Album: Scott & Mark Hoying (Republic Records) for Little Birdie's Big Symphony.

Best Comedy Album: Jeff Ross (Republic Records) for Take a Banana for the Ride.

UMG artists, UMPG, Downtown Music Publishing & Songtrust songwriters and composers, labels and distributed partners were also well represented across performance, album and craft categories, including Best Dance/Electronic Recording, Dance Pop Recording, Remixed Recording, Metal Performance, R&B Collaboration or Duo/Group Performance, Traditional R&B Performance, Melodic Rap Performance, Jazz Performance, Jazz Instrumental Album, Alternative Jazz Album, Contemporary Instrumental Album, American Roots Performance, Americana Performance, Contemporary Folk Album, Traditional Blues Album, Contemporary Blues Album, Gospel Performance/Song, Contemporary Christian Music Performance/Song, Contemporary Christian Music Album, Tropical Latin Album, African Music Performance, New Age, Ambient, or Chant Album, Children's Music Album, Comedy Album, Album Notes, Engineered Album, Non-Classical, Instrumental Composition, Arrangement, Instruments and Vocals, Choral Performance, Opera Recording and Contemporary Classical Composition, among others.

In addition, UMG signed and distributed recording artists including Laufey (Interscope Records/Verve Records), John Mayer (Sob Rock Records/Mercury Records), Quavo (Quality Control/Motown Records), Ayra Starr (Mavin/Republic Records) and Chris Stapleton (Mercury Nashville) received category nominations for featured recordings and performances.

The 69th Annual Grammy Awards will take place Sunday, February 7, 2027, at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles. The ceremony will air live on ABC and simulcast on Disney+ and Hulu. The Grammy Awards Premiere Ceremony will stream live on Disney+ earlier that day.

For the complete list of nominees, visit Grammy.com.

Featuring the most comprehensive catalogue of recordings and songs across every musical genre, UMG identifies and develops artists and produces and distributes the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music in the world. Committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship, UMG fosters the development of services, platforms and business models in order to broaden artistic and commercial opportunities for our artists and create new experiences for fans. For more information on Universal Music Group visit www.universalmusic.com.

releases.title: Washington Political Film Foundation Joins Georgetown and Notre Dame for Live, Two-Campus Conversation on America's 250 Years of Democracy
releases.body:
"A Republic, If We Can Keep It" brings together film, history and political scholarship on American democracy.

WASHINGTON, Nov. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- As the United States marks its 250th anniversary, the Washington Political Film Foundation (WPFF) will join Georgetown University and the University of Notre Dame on Nov. 18 to present A Republic, If We Can Keep It: 1776–2026, A Cross-Campus Conversation, a live event on American history and democracy.

Georgetown, Notre Dame and Washington Political Film Foundation explore 250 years of American democracy through film.

Presented with the Georgetown Democracy Initiative and Notre Dame Democracy Initiative, the program brings together students, faculty and scholars to examine the nation's founding ideals, defining moments and democratic future through film and political analysis.

"Film has a remarkable ability to bring history to life, challenge assumptions and spark conversations that matter," said Lee Johnson, Chairman and CEO of the Washington Political Film Foundation. "Our mission is centered on promoting civility and respectful engagement on college campuses. We are honored to work with Georgetown and Notre Dame to host this conversation."

Act One: Looking Back at 250 Years of American History Through Film

Audiences will see scenes from film, television and streaming productions depicting pivotal moments in American history. Panelists will examine how storytelling has shaped public understanding of the nation's founding, institutions, conflicts and ideals.

Act Two: Looking Forward to the Next 250 Years of American Democracy

After an intermission, the two campuses will connect live to discuss America's political future, the implications of the Nov. 3 midterm results and the nation's place at home and in the world.

Joel Day, Ph.D., is the Managing director of the Notre Dame Democracy Initiative, focusing on democratic pluralism and political and religious violence. Joining the Notre Dame panel will be David Campbell, Director of the Democracy Initiative and Professor of Political Science, an expert on civic education and the politics of religion, as well as Ricky Herbst, Cinema Program Director and Film Professor.

Hans Noel, Ph.D., is the director of research for the Georgetown Democracy Initiative. He is an associate professor of Government who studies American political parties and ideology. He will be joined by Amanda Sahar d'Urso, Ph.D., an assistant professor of government who studies racial identity.

Event Details

Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026, 5–7:30 p.m. EST

  • Georgetown University: New South Film Screening Classroom
  • University of Notre Dame: DeBartolo Performing ArtsCenter

About the Washington Political Film Foundation

The Washington Political Film Foundation is a nonpartisan 501(c)(3) educational charity that advances thoughtful political discourse through film.

releases.title: JALEN ROSE LAUNCHES POP THE TRUNK, A GENRE-DEFYING NEW SHOW THAT BREAKS THE MOLD OF TRADITIONAL SPORTS AND CULTURE PROGRAMMING
releases.body:
A trailblazer in athlete-driven media, Rose brings his hometown of Detroit to the forefront with a first-of-its-kind show featuring twice-weekly episodes and ongoing content

DETROIT, Nov. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Same Page Entertainment, the Detroit-based multi-media production company founded by NBA legend, media personality, and entrepreneur Jalen Rose and Platinum Equity Founder, Chairman and CEO, and Detroit Pistons owner Tom Gores, today announced the launch of Pop the Trunk. Hosted by Rose, Pop the Trunk premieres in January with twice-weekly episodes on YouTube and audio streaming platforms, while exclusive content, behind-the-scenes moments, and real-time social media commentary keep the conversation going between episodes.

Produced by Same Page Entertainment, Pop the Trunk draws inspiration from the golden era of appointment-viewing television while exploring the people, ideas, and moments shaping today's sports, culture, and entertainment landscape. The show will feature marquee interviews, skits, thoughtful analysis, animated content, live performances, and recurring segments like "Story Time with Jalen Rose," creating a dynamic entertainment experience designed to engage audiences wherever they watch, listen, and connect. Confirmed recurring guests include Detroit icons and hip-hop artists Sada Baby and Detroit Diamond, who bring distinct perspectives and cultural insight to the show. Filmed out of Same Page Entertainment's new content studio in downtown Detroit, Pop the Trunk will maintain a year-round presence across digital platforms while laying the groundwork for future live activations at major events nationwide.

"At its core, Pop the Trunk is about creating the kind of conversations that happen when great stories, different viewpoints, and authentic personalities come together," said Jalen Rose, Co-Founder and CEO of Same Page Entertainment. "We're opening the door to something entirely new at Same Page and building something entertaining, unpredictable, and rooted in community. Filming in Detroit is especially meaningful because this city shaped who I am, and we're excited to showcase its talent and resilience on a global stage."

For Rose, Pop the Trunk represents the latest evolution in a career spent redefining what athlete-driven media can be. Long before today's wave of athlete-hosted programming, he helped lay the blueprint for how athletes could extend their voices beyond the game, becoming one of the first active NBA players to build a career as a media personality while still playing. His acclaimed run as co-host of Jalen & Jacoby, nearly two decades as a lead analyst at ESPN, his original co-hosting of Get Up, and his current role as a college basketball analyst for TNT Sports helped pave the way for a generation of athletes who have leveraged their platforms into influential media enterprises. Now, Rose is betting on himself again, channeling his talents as a true Renaissance Man to push the boundaries of sports and entertainment with a format unlike anything else in the space.

The launch marks another major milestone for Same Page Entertainment, following its February 2026 debut and the premiere of its first original television series, South West High, on Tubi. The company also recently wrapped production on The Streak, its first feature film, which it co-produced and co-financed. Inspired by the remarkable true story of a college basketball team determined to break the longest losing streak in NCAA history, the uplifting sports comedy stars Ed Helms, Nina Dobrev, and Natasha Rothwell and is written and directed by Steve Byrne. Together, the projects reflect the company's mission to champion Detroit, invest in homegrown creative voices, and elevate resonant stories and perspectives for audiences worldwide.

ABOUT JALEN ROSE

Jalen Rose burst onto the scene as a member of the University of Michigan "Fab Five," followed by a successful 13-year NBA career. He is the Co-Founder and CEO of Same Page Entertainment, a Detroit-based multimedia production company founded alongside Tom Gores, rooted in building stories that celebrate culture, champion new voices, and spark meaningful conversations that bring communities closer together. He is currently a college basketball analyst for TNT Sports and spent 18 years as a lead analyst for ABC/ESPN. Despite all of his accolades, Rose has made his biggest contributions off the court by founding the Jalen Rose Leadership Academy in 2011. The open-enrollment, tuition-free public charter high school located in Detroit now serves more than 400 students annually and over 1,000 alumni. A college graduate, Rose recently earned his Honorary Doctor of Humane Letters degree from the University of Michigan. Currently a Board Member of the National Basketball Players Association Foundation, Rose's contributions to society through sports, philanthropy, and business have earned him numerous honors. He currently resides in Detroit.

ABOUT SAME PAGE ENTERTAINMENT

Same Page Entertainment is a Detroit-based, multi-media production company founded by Jalen Rose and Tom Gores. Same Page develops, produces, finances, and distributes scripted and unscripted film, television, and podcasts that spark conversation, celebrate culture, and elevate creators, particularly those from Detroit and Michigan. At Same Page, we believe everyone should be seen, be heard, and be understood. For more information, visit samepageentertainment.com or follow us at @samepageent.

releases.title: Regal Global Entertainment Elects Stacey Snider to Board of Directors
releases.body:
KNOXVILLE, Tenn., Nov. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Regal Global Entertainment (RGE) today announced that shareholders have elected Stacey Snider, one of Hollywood's most accomplished executives, to the company's Board of Directors.

Stacey Snider is a veteran studio leader who is currently Chief Creative Officer of FilmNation Entertainment, where she oversees the company's film and television slate and is part of its strategic leadership team. She previously served as Chairman and CEO of 20th Century Fox Film, Co-Chairman and CEO of DreamWorks Studios, and Chairman of Universal Pictures. Films released under Snider's executive leadership include Gladiator, The Fast and the Furious, The Bourne Identity, and Brokeback Mountain at Universal, The Help and Lincoln at DreamWorks, and The Martian, Logan, The Greatest Showman, and Bohemian Rhapsody at Fox.

Snider's experience spanning talent relationships, film development, production, marketing and distribution will bring further deep perspective to the Regal Global Entertainment board on how films reach audiences and the critical role theatrical exhibition plays in their success.

Brian McAndrews, Chair of the Board of Regal Global Entertainment, said: "Our industry depends on understanding what it takes to create films that resonate with audiences everywhere. Stacey has operated at the highest levels of Hollywood, building relationships with leading creative talent and making the decisions that shape how films are developed, marketed, and distributed around the world. She brings a rare combination of creative insight, strategic perspective, and firsthand knowledge of the forces shaping our business, and that will be invaluable as we continue to strengthen the role of the theatrical experience in the future of film."

"Stacey has spent her career creating new ways to bring audiences into movie theatres, so it means a great deal to have her join us," said Eduardo Acuña, Chief Executive Officer of Regal Global Entertainment. "She understands how filmmakers and studios decide where and how their films are seen. That's something we think about every day as we invest in premium formats and in the experience we give our guests, and we have seen that investment pay off in 2026 as our business and the industry have continued to flourish. I'm looking forward to learning from her, and to working with the whole board to drive further growth for years to come."

Stacey Snider said: "Every film I've worked on was made in the hope that people would watch it together in a theatre, and that hasn't changed for me. Regal Global Entertainment has been leading the way in terms of developing guest experience over the last two years, and that is reflected in terms of visits, loyalty, and spend. I look forward to working with Brian, Eduardo, and the board to help RGE build on that work around the world, in ways that benefit filmmakers, studios, and moviegoers."

Before joining FilmNation, Snider co-founded the international content company SISTER with Elisabeth Murdoch and Jane Featherstone and served as its Global CEO until 2023, building the company's U.S. business and Los Angeles operation and overseeing its film and television slate. Prior to her time at 20th Century Fox Film, DreamWorks Studios, and Universal Pictures, she was President of TriStar Pictures and Director of Development at The Guber / Peters Company.

About Regal Global Entertainment

Regal Global Entertainment operates the second largest theatrical exhibition business in the world with 7,637 screens across 628 locations. Through its Cinema City, Cineworld, Picturehouse, Planet, and Regal brands, the company is committed to delivering exceptional moviegoing experiences through premium large formats, innovative loyalty and subscription programs, enhanced food and beverage offerings, and outstanding guest service.

releases.body:
HANGZHOU, China and NEW YORK, Nov. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On November 12, NetEase Cloud Music, a leading music streaming service provider in China, and Sony Music Entertainment, a globally renowned record company, announced a strategic multi-year licensing agreement, further deepening their long-standing relationship in the digital music industry.

Leveraging Sony Music's extensive global music catalog and NetEase Cloud Music's strengths in digital music services and its vibrant community ecosystem in China, the renewed partnership will continue to bring high-quality licensed music to music fans across the country, while expanding collaboration across music content, artist promotion and cultural exchange.

Sony Music boasts an extensive international music catalog and a diverse roster of artists, with its recorded music business spanning a wide range of genres, including pop, rock, R&B, hip-hop and country.

Sony Music's catalog features some of the world's most influential artists, including Beyoncé, Michael Jackson, Harry Styles, P!nk, Céline Dion, Mariah Carey, Doja Cat, Whitney Houston, Shakira and Travis Scott, among many others.

Its Chinese-language artist roster features an impressive lineup of established artists and emerging talents, including Jam Hsiao, A-Lin, Curley G, Steve Chou, Gigi Yim, Lars Huang. Sony Music is also home to SKAI ISYOURGOD, one of the most prominent names in China's contemporary Chinese-language rap scene.

Sony Music also has an outstanding roster of artists across Japan and South Korea. Its Japanese music catalog includes popular artists such as Mika Nakashima, Hikaru Utada, Kenshi Yonezu, while its K-pop roster features internationally influential artists JENNIE and LISA.

William Ding, CEO of NetEase Cloud Music, said: "Sony Music Entertainment is a highly valued strategic partner of NetEase Cloud Music. This new partnership will further enrich our platform's global catalog of licensed music and provide users with access to a diverse range of high-quality music from outstanding artists. We look forward to working with Sony Music Entertainment to leverage our respective strengths in artist promotion and content co-creation, foster deeper connections between Chinese listeners and music artists, and contribute to the continued development of China's digital music market."

Vivian Wei, Vice President of Copyrights at NetEase Cloud Music, said: "We are delighted to further strengthen our strategic partnership with Sony Music Entertainment. NetEase Cloud Music has always been committed to providing users with high-quality and diverse music content, while leveraging our distinctive music community ecosystem to connect outstanding music with listeners. Sony Music Entertainment boasts an extensive global music catalog and an exceptional roster of artists. We look forward to building on this partnership to further expand the possibilities of digital music services, helping more international music be discovered and enjoyed by music fans in China, while creating more opportunities for artists to connect and engage with their audiences."

Andrew Chan, CEO of Sony Music Entertainment Greater China, said: "China is a vibrant and indispensable part of the global music ecosystem. We are delighted to deepen our long-standing strategic partnership with NetEase Cloud Music. Its distinctive music community and deep insight into young Chinese audiences create a special space for artists and fans. We look forward to bringing our rich catalog and world-class artists to more Chinese listeners, exploring innovative ways of engagement, and building stronger cultural connections through music."

About NetEase Cloud Music

NetEase Cloud Music ("Cloud Music Inc.," HKEX: 9899) is one of the leading online music platforms in China with over 200 million monthly active users, featuring an interactive content community for music enthusiasts in terms of user scale and engagement. NCM is also the leading original music platform in China, hosting more than 1.25 million independent musicians. NCM has built a large-scale, robust and rapidly growing business to provide community-centric online music services to its users. NCM empowers music enthusiasts with a wide variety of technology-driven tools to discover, enjoy, share and create diverse music and music-inspired content and to interact with each other.

About Sony Music Entertainment

Sony Music Entertainment is a global record label home to many renowned labels including RCA Records, Columbia Records and Epic Records. Committed to cross-border exchange of musical art, Sony Music Group introduces outstanding global pop music to the Chinese market while actively bringing Chinese-language music to the world stage, as well as discovering and developing original artists and music works across mainland China.

releases.title: Jason Voorhees Heads Back to Theaters in Historic 13th Feature Film
releases.body:
Legendary Friday the 13th Director Steve Miner Returns to Helm the Slasher Icon's Long-Awaited Big Screen Comeback

LOS ANGELES, Nov. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Jason Voorhees is returning to the big screen. Horror, Inc., under the leadership of the Barsamian family, today announced a new feature film slated for a global theatrical release in 2027. Returning to the franchise's independent roots, the film is financed and produced by the Barsamians. CatchLight Studios is named as the production partner, with Cineverse (NASDAQ: CNVS) securing North America distribution rights, including theatrical.

Arriving as the 13th feature film centered on the hockey-masked killer, this fresh entry welcomes a new generation of horror fans into the Jason Universe while delivering the practical kills and terror longtime Friday the 13th fans crave. To bring this long-awaited release to the big screen, the producers tapped legacy franchise director Steve Miner–who first put the machete in Jason's hands in Friday the 13th Part II and introduced the legendary hockey mask in Friday the 13th Part III–to direct the 2027 film from a script penned by emerging screenwriter David Fliegel.

"For generations of fans, Jason's identity is inseparable from the creative choices Steve Miner brought to the screen," said Robbie Barsamian, Executive Vice President of Horror, Inc. "Reuniting with Steve under a fully independent model allows us the creative control to honor what makes Jason the greatest slasher of all time and deliver the definitive theatrical event that today's audiences expect."

"When I put the hockey mask on Jason for Friday the 13th Part III, I knew it would create a truly scary image that would work for that movie," said Miner. "I had no idea that it would live on as one of the most iconic symbols in horror films. I'm thrilled to come back and continue the legacy."

"Jason is one of the most recognizable figures in cinema history," said Chris McGurk, Chairman and CEO of Cineverse. "We have a proven track record of empowering uncompromising genre filmmaking and connecting it directly with passionate audiences, and are honored to be a part of bringing Jason back to theaters where he belongs."

"Bringing an icon like Jason back to the screen requires dedication to craft and a deep respect for the fandom," said Jeanette Volturno, Co-Founder of Catchlight Studios. "We're excited to collaborate with Steve and Robbie to create a practically-shot film that is relentless, cinematic and terrifying."

For more than 45 years, the billion-dollar Friday the 13th franchise has remained a defining force in global pop culture and genre filmmaking, known for its classic scares, iconic kills, and multi-generational fan base that sets the standard for horror. The 13th film anchors the expanding Jason Universe that includes television (Crystal Lake), AAA gaming integrations (Call of Duty, Fortnite, Dead by Daylight, Friday the 13th: The Game), immersive experiences (Universal Studios' Halloween Horror Nights, Six Flags, Thirteenth Floor), and a robust merchandise portfolio.

Miner is represented by David Gersh of The Gersh Agency. Fliegel is represented by Sukee Chew at Hopscotch Pictures and Ethan Neale at Paradigm.

About Horror, Inc.

Horror, Inc., the creators of the Friday the 13th franchise, launched the Jason Universe in 2024 to usher in an era of expansion. Under the decades-long leadership of the Barsamian family, Horror, Inc. is currently developing a slate of new projects including the A24 prequel series "Crystal Lake" on Peacock (US), Crave (CAN), Sky (UK) and Stan (AUS). Friday the 13th premiered in theaters May 9, 1980, and went on to spawn 11 additional films, along with a television series, video games, comic books, collectibles, apparel and more over the next four decades. As Jason became a household name, the franchise evolved into one of the most prolific and successful horror franchises of all time. For the latest news and information on upcoming launches, follow @JasonUniverse13 on social media and visit JasonUniverse.com.

About Cineverse Motion Pictures Group

Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS) super-serves passionate audiences by distributing content across all windows and platforms, from theatrical to digital to physical. Following the breakout box office success of Terrifier 3, recent theatrical releases include the franchise returns of The Toxic Avenger, Silent Night, Deadly Night, and Return to Silent Hill, and the 20th anniversary release of Guillermo del Toro's masterpiece Pan's Labyrinth. On Cineverse's upcoming slate are the return of Jason Voorhees to theatres in the horror icon's 13th feature film, the third installment of Wolf Creek, a big screen adaptation of hit podcast Mayfair Watchers Society from Trevor Henderson (Siren Head, Cartoon Cat), and the company's first theatrical family feature, Air Bud Returns.

About CatchLight Studios

CatchLight Studios is an independent film and television company founded by Jeanette Volturno, Marcei Brown, Jason Clark, and Jessica Malanaphy, whose partners have produced more than 175 films across four decades. CatchLight most recently produced GABBY'S DOLLHOUSE: THE MOVIE (Universal/DreamWorks), starring Kristen Wiig and Gloria Estefan; HERETIC (A24), from Scott Beck and Bryan Woods with Stacey Sher, starring Hugh Grant; and Tim Story's THE BLACKENING (Lionsgate/MRC), a Toronto International Film Festival official selection.

As the first hires at Blumhouse, Volturno and Malanaphy pioneered the low-cost, high-output model that launched global franchises including INSIDIOUS, THE PURGE, and PARANORMAL ACTIVITY, championing filmmakers such as James Wan, Scott Derrickson, and Jordan Peele. Brown brings Oscar-caliber production pedigree as a co-producer of Jordan Peele's cultural landmark GET OUT. Clark is an award-winning producer whose film and television credits include 42, ACT OF VALOR, the record-breaking TED franchise, COSMOS, and THE ORVILLE. He also helped pioneer modern CG storytelling with STUART LITTLE, architected DreamWorks' 3D pipeline, and spent a decade as President of Seth MacFarlane's Fuzzy Door.

releases.title: Cook County Treasurer Maria Pappas to Mark Diwali with Music, Dancing and a Recognition Ceremony for Indian Community Leaders
releases.body:
CHICAGO, Nov. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cook County Treasurer Maria Pappas and Indian Consul General Dr. M. Anand Prakash will host a Diwali celebration featuring music and dance. Indian American community leaders, activists and entrepreneurs will also be recognized for their outstanding contributions to the cultural, civic and economic life of Cook County. The event will be held at 2 p.m. on Friday, November 13, 2026, in the Cook County Treasurer's Office, 118 N. Clark St., Room 112, Chicago.

Pappas will present certificates of recognition to individuals who have made meaningful impacts in business, education, public service, advocacy and the arts. Honorees represent the vibrancy and economic vitality of the Indian American community across the region.

Diwali, known as the Festival of Lights, is one of the most widely celebrated holidays in India and among Indian communities worldwide. The five-day celebration symbolizes the triumph of light over darkness and good over evil. It is marked by lighting lamps, sharing meals, exchanging gifts and offering prayers for prosperity and peace. In the Chicago area, where more than 250,000 residents trace their roots to India, Diwali holds deep cultural and spiritual significance for the second-largest Indian diaspora in America.

"The Indian American community plays an essential role in shaping the identity of Cook County," said Pappas. "I believe in the power of positive thinking, so Diwali is a favorite annual celebration. It's a time to come together and reflect on the good in the world—and to honor individuals who bring light into the lives of others through their service, leadership, and accomplishments."

The Diwali celebration at the Treasurer's Office is part of an ongoing effort by Pappas to recognize the diverse communities that make Cook County one of the most dynamic and inclusive places in the nation.

releases.title: iQIYI's "The Shadow's Edge" Gains Further Industry Recognition as Tony Ka-fai LEUNG Wins Best Actor at the Golden Rooster Awards
releases.body:
BEIJING, Nov. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On November 10, Tony Ka-fai LEUNG won Best Actor at the 39th Golden Rooster Awards for his performance in iQIYI-produced action-crime film "The Shadow's Edge." The award was presented at the ceremony in Xiamen, China. Earlier, "The Shadow's Edge" received three nominations at this year's Golden Rooster Awards, including Best Actor, Best Actress and Best Supporting Actor.

At the ceremony, the Golden Rooster Awards jury recognized LEUNG's ability to portray the character's complexity through both powerful action and subtle emotional expression. In his acceptance speech, LEUNG expressed his gratitude to director Larry YANG, Jackie CHAN, the Jackie Chan Stunt Team and the film's production companies, including iQIYI, Damai Entertainment and Hairun Pictures, for their collective efforts. This also marked LEUNG's first Golden Rooster Award in his more than 40-year acting career, following his first nomination.

Established in 1981, the Golden Rooster Awards are among China's most prestigious film honors, recognizing outstanding achievements in filmmaking. The latest win adds to the track record of iQIYI, China's leading online entertainment platform, in producing high-quality films, following previous Golden Rooster Awards wins and nominations for titles such as "Let Life Be Beautiful," "Tough Out" and "Ping Pong: The Triumph."

A Powerful Performance in a High-Stakes Action Crime Thriller

Directed by Larry YANG and starring global action star Jackie CHAN, Zifeng ZHANG and veteran Hong Kong actor Tony Ka-fai LEUNG, "The Shadow's Edge" follows an elite law enforcement team drawn into a cat-and-mouse chase through the dynamic streets of Macao as they pursue a sophisticated criminal gang. The film pits old-school human intuition against modern high-tech surveillance.

LEUNG plays Longsheng FU, the calculating mastermind leading a crew of elusive master thieves. His performance captures the character's contrasting sides, shifting between a sophisticated, composed appearance and ruthless personality, while delivering demanding action scenes, including a memorable one-against-30 fight sequence.

Box Office Success and International Recognition

Released theatrically in 2025, "The Shadow's Edge" earned RMB 1.265 billion (190 million USD) at the Chinese box office and received strong audience reviews, becoming one of the year's standout action-crime films.

The film also reached audiences in more than 30 countries and regions, ranking among Malaysia's top 10 highest-grossing Chinese-language films of all time. It was featured in the Open Cinema section of the Busan International Film Festival and the Limelight programme of the International Film Festival Rotterdam, two major international film festivals. LEUNG also won Best Actor at the 44th Hong Kong Film Awards, one of Asia's leading film honors, for the same role.

iQIYI Extends the Film's Value from the Big Screen to Streaming

Beyond its theatrical success, "The Shadow's Edge" continued its strong performance following its online release on iQIYI in November 2025, topping multiple viewership charts and attracting strong audience engagement. Its performance across both theatrical and streaming releases highlights iQIYI's ability to extend the value of high-quality theatrical films through its streaming platform.

Building on the success of the first film, the iQIYI-produced sequel "The Shadow's Edge 2" began filming in Huizhou, Guangdong, in October 2026, extending the story into its next chapter.

Through projects such as "The Shadow's Edge," iQIYI remains committed to producing high-quality films, supporting creative talent and bringing compelling Chinese stories to audiences in China and around the world.

releases.title: B2K'S ECLIPSE SURPASSES 100,000 TICKET-AND-ALBUM BUNDLE SALES AHEAD OF RELEASE
releases.body:
The Boys 4 Life Tour Paired Arena Tickets with B2K's First Studio Album in Nearly 24 Years, Which Hit No. 1 on Apple Music Upon Release

B2K's First Studio Album Lands Playlist Covers on YouTube Music and Audiomack

HOUSTON, Nov. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- BPC Music Group bet its inaugural album release on B2K, the platinum-selling R&B quartet that hadn't released a studio album in nearly 24 years. Working with Black Promoters Collective, the label paired B2K's new album, ECLIPSE, with tickets to the nationwide Boys 4 Life Tour, selling 138,000 ticket-and-album bundles. That momentum carried into release week. ECLIPSE reached No. 1 on Apple Music upon its November 6 release, and B2K landed playlist covers on YouTube Music and Audiomack, an exclusive Rolling Out cover and a slate of new-music placements.

Stream or purchase ECLIPSE [ALBUM SMART LINK]

B2K and BPC Music Group call the approach "newstalgia." The tour brought Omarion, J-Boog, Lil' Fizz and Raz-B back together in front of fans who grew up with their music. By including ECLIPSE with tour tickets, B2K gave those fans a way to discover the new album through the same live experience that brought them back to the group's biggest hits. The collaboration carried into the studio, with tour co-headliner Bow Wow joining B2K on "Boyfriend."

For BPC Music Group founders Gary Guidry and Troy Brown, both partners in Black Promoters Collective, the campaign put an established sales tactic to work in the streaming era. The two companies used the arena tour as a direct channel for selling new music, reaching fans at the moment they bought their tickets. The 138,000 bundles measure the reach of that offer and give the label another way to gauge the success of a release alongside chart performance, playlist support and media coverage.

"We chose B2K for our first album release because we believed the connection they built with their fans could carry new music nearly 24 years later. The Boys 4 Life Tour gave us a way to make that music part of an experience fans were already excited about. That's what we mean by newstalgia. We want to broaden what a successful release looks like in the streaming era, and for B2K that starts with the fans who showed up," said Troy Brown, Co-Founder, BPC Music Group.

During release week, ECLIPSE and its tracks were available across more than 32 digital music services, including Apple Music, Spotify, Amazon Music, YouTube Music, Pandora, Qobuz and Beatport. B2K appeared on the covers of YouTube Music's Grown Folks Choice and Audiomack's Verified: R&B. The album appeared in Rated R&B's "9 Essential New R&B Releases," Billboard's "Friday Music Guide" and more. Rolling Out marked the group's return with its exclusive B2K Cover Experience.

WHAT THE PRESS IS SAYING ABOUT B2K'S ECLIPSE

"With their album 'Eclipse' and single 'Mileage,' the group is embracing its signature sound while bringing a more mature perspective to the genre they helped define."

— EBONY

"B2K's reunion means more than releasing new music … the bandmates bring their individual experiences and personal growth to their new music, inviting their longtime fans along for the ride."

— theGrio

"A smooth collection of songs that drifts between slow-burn intimacy and slinky grooves, with romance at its core."

— Rated R&B

"ECLIPSE aims to seamlessly blend the group's signature vocal harmonies and brotherhood with a contemporary R&B edge."

— YouKnowIGotSoul

"B2K is making a comeback!"

— HotNewHipHop

Lead single "Mileage" reached No. 1 on Apple Music's R&B Songs and R&B Videos charts and climbed to No. 23 on Billboard's Mainstream R&B/Hip-Hop Airplay chart. B2K followed with "Lil Freak" and released "Co-Sign," written and produced by The Underdogs, alongside the album. Ahead of release, B2K performed a medley of new music and signature hits on NBC's TODAY on November 4.

About BPC Music Group

Founded by Black Promoters Collective partners Gary Guidry and Troy Brown, BPC Music Group is an independent record label that brings live entertainment and recorded music together. B2K's ECLIPSE is the label's inaugural album release.

releases.title: MUSIC HALL HONORS ITS CHAMPIONS TINA & LELAND BASSETT
releases.body:
DETROIT, Nov. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Tina & Leland Bassett, partners in life and in work, have together supported Music Hall for a combined 100+ years! They are Trustees, contributors, and above all – the most steadfast and loyal friends.

On Sunday November 15, in a gathering of Music Hall friends & family, we will unveil a commissioned portrait of the Bassetts. Created over several sittings this summer, the portrait is stunning in its likeness of Tina & Leland – not only the physical aspect, but in the emotional energy that it captures between two people with a bond so strong it defies definition.

Tina and Leland exemplify the values of dedication and service. They have stood with Detroit through thick and thin and believe fiercely in the city's exceptional talent.

Their support of and belief in our work is captured in the quote featured prominently on the wall of The Tina & Leland Bassett Lounge, on our 3rd floor. "Art is the soul of humanity. The performing arts discover, preserve, and present the human expression of that soul. Music Hall is the unique and perfect venue for the celebration of who we are and who we can become."

The work was made by English muralist and portraitist Richard Wilson, who now joyfully calls himself a Detroiter. Richard entered the Music Hall orbit when he proposed and completed, in 2019, a most mammoth of passion projects – the mural of Stevie Wonder on our building's back wall. The work has now become a global icon for our city. He received the opportunity to paint a portrait of the Bassetts as an honor. RW: "The Bassetts' encouragement and belief in me as I pursue my passion of portrait painting is something that has elevated my work. What I really aimed to capture is the love that exists between them." We think he surely did.

Unveiling of the portrait, which will be on permanent display for the public in the Lounge, precedes a 7:30pm performance by the inimitable Patti LaBelle. Tickets are still available at www.ticketmaster.com or at Music Hall box office by calling 313-887-8501.

NASHVILLE, Tenn., Nov. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Anzie Blue Records and Apple Music today announced the release of Apple Music's Color Me Country Radio with Rissi Palmer radio special and highlight video for By Any Means: The Album, in conversation with the album's musical director Pynk Beard and performing artists Steve Ray Ladson and Denitia.

The radio special is available now for on-demand streaming on Apple Music's Color Me Country Radio show page. A 37-minute highlight video of the Apple Music studio conversation is also available for playing on the Apple Music artist pages for Pynk Beard, Steve Ray Ladson, Denitia, and Rissi Palmer. The radio special will air globally for free on Apple Music 1 at 5 PM Eastern Time on Sunday, November 15.

In this special episode of Color Me Country Radio, Rissi Palmer is joined by Pynk Beard, Denitia, and Steve Ray Ladson to discuss the making of By Any Means: The Album, recorded at Muscle Shoals' historic FAME Studios. The project reimagines iconic civil rights-era hits through a powerhouse lineup of contemporary Black roots artists. Together, they unpack how the album reclaims the deep historical through-line of Southern Black culture; from food and family to soul and country music. This potent combination of music and conversation serves as a living testament to community, authenticity, and "joy as resistance."

Palmer explained in the episode why By Any Means: The Album resonated with her: "One of the themes of Color Me Country for the last couple years has been 'joy as resistance.' Because the world is so dark, because the music business is so bleak sometimes, I wanted to make sure that we kept the focus on 'and still we persist' and 'still we rise' and 'we're still here.' And so if my ancestors can find reasons to sing and dance and make love and make music and make babies and make good food and all that kind of stuff, so can I. And so this album to me, this community, this pairing, this group of artists that you aggregated is one of the most perfect examples of joy as resistance.

The episode was filmed at Apple Music's Nashville studio, and was preceded by a visit to United Record Pressing. Founded in 1949, United Record Pressing was the first vinyl processing plant in the American south, and was a crucial record processing plant for Black-owned independent record companies like Motown and Vee-Jay Records (who released The Beatles' debut American single and album).

The By Any Means artists visited United Record Pressing's recreation of the "Motown Suite," where Black Motown artists and executives could lodge amid segregation. State Fair of Texas emcee Ian Saint presented Pynk Beard with a vinyl art gift by Dallas-based artist Mikki Mallow, that commemorated Pynk Beard's State Fair of Texas main stage performance with fellow By Any Means: The Album artists Steve Ray Ladson and The BoykinZ on the day after the album's release.

Apple Music's By Any Means: The Album episode premiere date coincides with Ole Smoky Roadshow's coast to coast Music & Moonshine: The By Any Means Album Tour, which launched in Palmer's hometown of St. Louis on November 6. The Ole Smoky Roadshow tour features Pynk Beard and Ladson, plus album artists Elsie and Stella Prince; with special guests Tone Stith, 2'Live Bre, and Tatiana Marie Clark at select shows.

Color Me Country Radio host Rissi Palmer selected a local opening act at every show. Palmer — who received the Academy of Country Music's 2024 ACM Lift Every Voice Award — remarks "Color Me Country Radio and The Color Me Country Foundation are so proud to have handpicked each of the openers for this tour. I believe in lifting up my peers through grants and opportunities, and this partnership with Anzie Blue Records and Ole Smoky Distillery has made that mission possible with this historic and culturally significant tour. Y'all are in for a soulful and joyful experience!"

By Any Means: The Album is inspired by the feature film BY ANY MEANS, starring Mark Wahlberg and Yahya Abdul-Matteen II, distributed domestically by Paramount Pictures. The film, directed by Elegance Bratton, was inspired by the true story of Mississippi civil rights activist Vernon Dahmer Sr. — and the FBI hiring New York mobster Greg Scapa to help investigate Dahmer's 1966 murder by KKK members.

Musically directed by Anzie Blue Records' country artist and GRAMMY®-nominated songwriter Pynk Beard, By Any Means: The Album brings together artists across generations and genres to reinterpret songs connected to the sound and spirit of the 1960s. Brandy, Kashus Culpepper, Keb' Mo', Tone Stith, and others put their own stamp on songs from iconic artists — including three performers in the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's premiere induction class: Ray Charles, Sam Cooke, and James Brown.

Much of the album was recorded at FAME Studios in Muscle Shoals, Alabama in less than a week — bringing the project to a place with deep roots in American soul music and to Pynk Beard's home state. Pynk Beard elaborated in the Apple Music episode about how gathering artists in Muscle Shoals created a real community: "It meant the world to me to be able to call a Reyna Roberts and a Denitia, and a Keb' Mo', and a Brandy and say, 'Hey, babies. Please, I love you and I appreciate what you do. Come help me do this.' It still hits me from time to time. We did that. That really happened. We met in Muscle Shoals. We went to work together… I got to hug these people. I got to take pictures with them. We got to chat. I got to get to know them… It starts with the people. The sound comes from the people."

Denitia concurred, saying in the episode that "Recording in Muscle Shoals is so special. Walking into FAME, you can feel it. You can feel the legacy. You can feel how just so much great music has been made there and so much sweat was put into it. And making music and being an artist, especially being a Black artist at that time, it's not as easy as it is today."

Ladson added, "Just to have all of that talent in one room and knowing Muscle Shoals to be like a staple for where a lot of the hippies and a lot of the Black musicians got their start. Rick Hall took a chance back then letting the cats come in there and record… like Aretha, Arthur Alexander and all that. So, it was hard for us to get recording back then. Percy Sledge got his first hit out of there, you know what I'm saying? So, that's another reason why I wanted to be there… to be around a bunch of artists that's making history right now from the history there, it's kind of like rolling over into time. They couldn't have picked a better place to do it."

By Any Means: The Album is bookended by the original title track written by 17-time Oscar® nominee Diane Warren, performed by Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees The Isley Brothers and Nashville singer-songwriter David Kushner. The "By Any Means" original title track makes The Isley Brothers the latest of more than 40 Rock Hall inductees to release a Diane Warren composition. The "By Any Means" music video, directed by Fran Strine and available for playing on Apple Music, has been nominated for a Hollywood Music in Media Award (HMMA) for Best Music Video.

Net proceeds from By Any Means: The Album benefit the Black Music Action Coalition (BMAC), supporting the organization's work to advance equity, expand opportunity, and create pathways for the next generation of artists, creatives, and music industry professionals.

releases.body:
Executive Produced by Keith Sweat's KDS Entertainment and Created and Directed by Darrin Dewitt Henson, the Series Explores Brotherhood, Family, Resilience and the Lasting Impact of Foster Care.

NEW YORK, Nov. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- R&B icon Keith Sweat expands his entertainment 2026 on Tubi. Joining forces with acclaimed actor, director, choreographer and producer Darrin Dewitt Henson, who created, directed and stars in the drama, Sweat brings decades of entertainment experience to a powerful story of brotherhood, survival and family. View the trailer HERE.

Twin Pillars: A Series follows fraternal twin brothers Dre (Henson) and Maurice (Alimi Ballard, General Hospital), whose lives change dramatically when their parents' incarceration places them in foster care. As the brothers take different paths, the series examines how childhood adversity, separation and defining choices shape their identities, relationships and futures. Through the brothers' contrasting journeys, the series invites viewers to consider how support, opportunity and personal choices influence healing and hope.

For Sweat, whose legendary career has helped define R&B for more than three decades, the project represents another milestone in his evolution as an entertainer and producer. With more than 25 million records sold, multiple platinum certifications, over 14 studio albums and five consecutive No. 1 albums, Sweat continues expanding his influence across music, television, film, entrepreneurship and philanthropy. His next single, "Think Love," is scheduled for release in 2027.

"Music has always been my way of connecting with people through stories that speak to real-life experiences. As an executive producer and actor on Twin Pillars: A Series, I can bring that same passion for storytelling to television. This series explores family, adversity and the choices that shape our lives. Darrin has created something meaningful, and I'm proud to help bring audiences a story that entertains while sparking important conversations about resilience and second chances." — Keith Sweat, Executive Producer and Actor

Henson has built a distinguished career across film, television, music and dance. Recognized for his memorable roles in Soul Food: The Series, Stomp the Yard and BET's The Family Business, he is also an influential choreographer and accomplished producer. As creator, director and star of Twin Pillars: A Series, Henson brings his multidisciplinary experience to a character-driven narrative examining family separation, the foster care experience and the emotional bonds between siblings.

"Twin Pillars: A Series is more than a story about two brothers. It's about the circumstances that shape us, the decisions that define us and the family connections that remain even when life pulls us in different directions. I wanted to create a series that reflects the complexity of the human experience, particularly for children whose lives are disrupted by circumstances they did not create. Having Keith Sweat join as executive producer and actor brings incredible experience and creative energy. Together, we're telling a story that I believe will resonate long after the credits roll." — Darrin Dewitt Henson, Creator, Director and Actor

Blending emotionally resonant performances with socially relevant storytelling, Twin Pillars: A Series features an ensemble cast including Fat Joe, Sean Anthony Baker, Crystal Coney, Chris Greene, Tia Hendricks, Africa Miranda, Nicole Murphy, Alan Silva, Justin Sweat and Darnell Winston.

With Sweat and Henson collaborating in front of and behind the camera, the drama offers a compelling exploration of loyalty, resilience, redemption and the enduring meaning of family.

Twin Pillars: A Series premieres late November 2026 on Tubi.

The film follows Grammy- and Emmy-winning composer Mark Isham as he creates At the Carousel Club, his first new album in 15 years, bringing together jazz improvisation and electronic music.

Award-nominated documentary follows Mark Isham as he creates his first album in 15 years.

The documentary captures Isham's collaboration with renowned musicians Vinnie Colaiuta (drums), Nels Cline (guitar), Kaveh Rastegar (bass), Ayo Awosika (vocals) and the Orchid Quartet (strings). It also explores the experiences and musical influences that have shaped his career.

"Mark was very generous in allowing us into his creative jet stream, and he worked closely with us to ensure our cameras had access to all the key moments, from his personal home studio to his recording sessions at the legendary Mad Hatter Studios," said Taron Lexton, creative director of the documentary.

The film incorporates animation and visual effects to bring moments from Isham's past to the screen, including his early experiences with the trumpet, the musicians who influenced his sound and his quest to develop his own musical voice. The documentary's score is drawn from Isham's own music, using elements of his original recordings to accompany the story of his life and creative process.

"Because Mark's music and story have such epic scope and depth, VFX and animation felt like an essential element to do it justice. And because the VFX team at SMP is utterly world class, this became a creative pillar of the documentary," said Lexton.

Mark Isham: The Voice Within premiered October 11 on Scientology Network and is available to watch at scientology.tv/markisham.

Scientology Network debuted on March 12, 2018, launched by David Miscavige, ecclesiastical leader of the Scientology religion. Since then, Scientology Network has been viewed in over 240 countries and territories worldwide in 17 languages. Satisfying the curiosity of people about Scientology, the network takes viewers across six continents, spotlighting the everyday lives of Scientologists, showing the Church as a global organization and presenting its Social Betterment programs that have touched the lives of millions worldwide. The network also showcases documentaries by independent filmmakers who represent a cross section of cultures and faiths, but share a common purpose of uplifting communities. Scientology Network's innovative content has been recognized with more than 175 industry awards, including Tellys, Communitas and Hermes Creative Awards.

Broadcast from Scientology Media Productions, the Church's global media center in Los Angeles, the Scientology Network is available on DIRECTV Channel 320, DIRECTV STREAM, AT&T U-verse and can be streamed at scientology.tv, on mobile apps and via the Roku, Amazon Fire and Apple TV platforms.

releases.title: SmallRig Partners With Macao International Documentary Film Festival on New Award for Real Life-Storytelling
releases.body:
MACAO, Nov. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On the closing night of the 9th Macao International Documentary Film Festival (MOIDF) on November 8, From Dawn to Dawn won the first-ever SmallRig Real Image Special Award.

From Dawn to Dawn, directed by Xisi Sofia Ye Chen, spends its time with Awen, a second-generation Chinese immigrant living in Spain, and the small details of his everyday life. It came out on top of six other finalists in the festival's new Emerging Directors Competition. The award is a milestone for MOIDF, too. It's the first time the festival has joined forces with an imaging brand to honor real-life storytelling.

A festival that keeps growing

Alongside its local competition, held every two years, the festival launched a new competition open to entries from anywhere in the world. The seven finalists dealt with migrant identity, daily life in wartime, and the closeness and friction between family members.

The SmallRig Real Image Special Award, created together with the festival, recognizes work that uses film to serve the public good and help society move forward. Its jury was veteran documentary cinematographer Xue Ming, Hong Kong writer-director Au Cheuk-man, and Gao Haiyan, co-founder of SmallRig and chair of the SmallRig Image Development Fund.

Two questions every film had to answer

The first was authenticity: Does the filmmaker portray the scene honestly, observe with patience, and treat the people on screen with respect? The second was social value: Does the work address issues that deserve attention, open a window onto other people's lives and inspire audiences to care, and even to act?

From Dawn to Dawn met both criteria. According to the citation, the film captures the identity struggles of second-generation Chinese in Spain through the small details of everyday life, arriving at a humane expression of letting go and making peace with oneself.

Gao Haiyan said the film embodies the kind of authenticity that both SmallRig and the festival champion: "It can begin with 'I' and go on to inspire others. This truth flows with life, and it moves us because it is intimate."

Zhou Yang, founder and CEO of SmallRig, said: "We created this award to encourage more creators to document real life, connect with more people through film, and make visual storytelling more powerful."

SmallRig and the Stories Behind the Lens

The SmallRig Awards honor finished films and help them find an audience. Their first edition received 3,891 entries from more than 120 countries. A social-impact film pitching forum helps projects in development through expert review, pitching and industry connections.

For SmallRig, the new award is another step on a long road, and a way to put its weight behind the kind of films it wants to see more of.
